strings.helpBody: Here you can add dialogue that plays before or after the level. Only dialogue already present in the game can be selected; custom dialogue is not supported. With the Creative Courtyard module, narrative dialogue plays every time the level is entered.
strings.unavailableDialogue: This dialogue has no usable starting text and cannot be selected

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Those peashooters are confused and are just going to be in the way.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Use the shovel to dig them up and make room for useful plants!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hey neighbor!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Can I borrow that hot sauce?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I've been holding onto this taco for forever!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Oh! That was... AMAZING!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I want to eat THAT taco again! I need my TIME MACHINE!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Her name is Penny and I'm Crazy Dave. But you can call me Crazy Dave.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Finally, another User who can process my queries.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let me postulate, Dave wants to go back in time to eat his taco... again...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: She's so smart! Now let's go after my taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Do you want to take a look?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This is a world map!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Click on the Plant Food jumping around, it should be able to help us!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
It appears to be some sort of gate... of stars.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I'll call it GATESTAR!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Actually that is a Star Gate.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The map shows you where new Stars can be earned!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: By earning enough Stars we can unlock the gate...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: And travel to another time!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's just crazy enough to work!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Dear neighbor, I've found a great place. Come check it out with me!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Plants can now become even more powerful. You can upgrade them up to three times!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Be careful! The zombie army is coming!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Where do you think the future will take us?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Practicing advanced planting techniques in the Endless Zones...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Will keep you sharp for future trials.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Just remember, Tomorrow is always a taco...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
It may look like the end of the road...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But the road goes on when searching for a taco on the space-time continuum.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
In the meantime, be sure to practice advanced planting techniques in the Endless Zones.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Penny is right. It's important to stay sharp.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: You never know when you might find zombies on your lawn.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Or me on your lawn.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Or my taco on your lawn.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Really, you just don't know.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But if you do find my taco on your lawn...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Could you put it in the fridge?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Good news! Penny found a map to my taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
No, that is a time-space map to the worlds we could explore.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Mummies and pirates and cowboys, oh my!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We should be able to find some way to access the other worlds.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: For now we're ready to press on in Ancient Egypt!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Welcome to the first stop of our trip, the mysterious ancient Egypt.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Is this Egypt? I heard that the Egyptian Pharaoh had countless treasures. Maybe you can find a lot of good things here.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I don't know what's good, but there are quite a few zombies, so prepare to fight.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
This guy wears armor on his head like me, he looks very powerful!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
This guy with the bucket looks very powerful. Try the Plant Food just now and drag it onto the pea!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
Well done! There is an unlimited supply of Plant Food in this level, so let's beat the zombies into bits of mud!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 2 (Cabbage-pult Plant Food Tutorial I, 1/2)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Let's try what happens if the Cabbage-pult eats Plant Food!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 2 (Cabbage-pult Plant Food Tutorial I, 2/2)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Well done! So gorgeous! Let's move on!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
The explorer zombie's torch will instantly kill plants, and we can use Iceburg Lettuce to extinguish the flames.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
Watch out for the coming sandstorms, which often contain zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 5 (Camel Signs Introduction, Intro)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
What are those zombies holding?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They are holding Camel cards, and plants that can penetrate bullets can effectively deal with them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
My Gügle translator indicates the zombies have a plan.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Is that a brain grill?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 5 (Power-Up Purchase Introduction, Legacy)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
If you want to use a Power Up, you can buy one with coins!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Just tap on that doohickey down there and you're in business!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 6 (Cactus Plant Food Tutorial II, 1/2)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Let's try what happens if a cactus eats Plant Food!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 6 (Cactus Plant Food Tutorial II, 2/2)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Well done! So gorgeous! Let's move on!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 7 (Hard Mode; Legacy Mummy Memory II)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Match the symbols and win a prize!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
What's the prize?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I don't know. I'm Crazy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 8 (Legacy Last Stand I)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
This will be the first last stand. There will be more lasts to come.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 9 (Tomb Raiser Zombie Introduction)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
It's a Tomb Raiser Zombie. They will keep summoning tombstones, so get rid of him quickly.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 10 (Conveyor Belt Introduction; Legacy Special Delivery, Intro)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
No need for sun.  Plants are coming via special delivery.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 12 (Hard Mode; Legacy Mummy Memory III)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
What's the new symbol?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I don't know. Feelin' lucky?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 15 (International Day 25, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Have you ever wondered why your neighbor David hungers so?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: What secret ingredient in the taco would drive his desire?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Could it be that he needs your brains as much as we do?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Wha-?! No way. I would never eat a brain taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But, I don't remember what was in it...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 15 (International Day 25, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Wait a minute!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: There was never any meat in that taco.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I still have Tofunky in my beard to prove it!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave leaves.)
Well, that just leaves more brains for us... later.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I'll find you again, in another where and another when!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Welcome to Ancient Egypt!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Please wait 4500 years for your taco to be ready... more or less.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That doesn't smell right.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I'm sure my taco is around here somewhere, but in the meantime...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: These plants were made for plantin'.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 1 (International, Plant Food Tutorial, 1/2)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Those plants look hungry.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: If only there was something that you could feed them...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Plant Food is packed with vitamins and minerals.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It's an essential part of a complete breakfast.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 1 (International, Plant Food Tutorial, 2/2)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I wonder if Plant Food works on other types of plants?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 1 (International, Plant Food Tutorial Failure)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Aww...you let your plant get eaten! Try again!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Now this looks like the map to my taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
To be precise this is a world map where we can find plants that can help us and...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: User Dave, there are more important things at hand than...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let's go get my taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 7 (Intro, Mummy Memory Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Oh good. There are no zombies here.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
False. They're using camouflage.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You mean they're using... camel-flage.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Dear neighbor, Lucky Treasure not only contains plants and costumes, but pendants too!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: What, don't you know? Go and see!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Whoa... this world goes to eleven! That's crazy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
That was the last mummy.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
That's a WRAP!!!! HAHAHAHAH!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: According to my gauges...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: User Dave has been waiting to use that joke since we got here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Do you know what's better than a wrap? A Taco. Let's go!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Awesome! I've always wanted to eat one of those.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Wait... that's not a starfish. It's an actual star.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Ugh, you can have it.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Locked and Loaded I (Legacy)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
This level is a locked coordinate in time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You must take these plants to win.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Otherwise, you risk distorting reality.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Never distort reality! You'll pull something.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Locked and Loaded II (Legacy)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Can't we build a modern fence to stop these ancient zombies?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Who needs fences when you have offense?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Locked and Loaded III (Legacy)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
The family that pults together...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Are friends indeed.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Save Our Seeds I (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
There's a plant call on the banana phone. It's an S.O.S.!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
They'll be sitting plants if we don't help. Let's take that root and save them!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Save Our Seeds II (Legacy)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
My sensors have detected plants in danger.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Who will save the plants? WHO?!??
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Save Our Seeds III (Legacy)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
There's too many tombs. Let's clear them out.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I'm hyperventilating I'm so excited right now.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Is this Last Stand?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
No, it's First Sit.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's sarcasm.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I love sitting, but now is not the time! Let's get crazy.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
I hope that pharaohs had some heirs.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I guess that was their last stand too.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
There's a brand new symbol to match. It's a bucket.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Let's kick it.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 6 (International Gargantuar Level, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Greetings Temporal Commuters,
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Special couriers have been dispatched to retrieve your brains.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Please have your release forms signed before their arrival.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Regards, Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Cool, that Mr. Boss guy wants your autograph!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This can't be good.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 6 (International Gargantuar Level, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
It looks like a courier had his own delivery to make!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: These will be useful for traveling to other times.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Yeah! Time to try the Taco Map!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Day 12 (International Endless Zone Unlock, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Though tetrahedrons are pyramids, this one is not a Platonic solid.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I'm so hungry, I would love a Platonic solid.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, this is also not a taco salad.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Dr. Zomboss Battle (Unused, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Welcome to mysterious Egypt, my friend.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I'm surprised to see me here.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Then let me show you the new weapon I made using the inspiration I got from the pyramid!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Why does that guy look so familiar?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It is detected that the opponent's combat power is red danger level.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We have to find a way to kill it before we can move forward.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Ancient Egypt - Dr. Zomboss Battle (Unused, Outro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
How? This is impossible!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: My works will be defeated. This is not scientific at all!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: There must be something wrong. When I find out the reason, I will come back!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Hey! Man, where are those tacos you promised?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Look! Now there's a star on the time-space map!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: What could it all mean...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Stars appear on the map where you earned them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Stars could help us get back to the year 2009 and your taco.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Well let's get going and find some more!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
Empty stars show where you can go to earn stars.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Good news! Penny found a map to my taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
No, that is a time-space map to the plants that can help us.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let's go get my taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I thought we were trying to get back home and get your taco.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But Pirates! Hang on to your parrots and peg legs!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Shiver me timbers. I've always wanted to do some swashbuckling.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And I've always wanted a poop deck of my own.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Yes, let's go. I'd hate for him to improvise a poop deck here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
I love the smell of coconut cannons in the morning!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Smells like... well, coconuts.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Day 3 (Legacy Locked and Loaded I)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Butter and spikes and everything nice.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's what butter and spikes are made of.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
That's hard to argue or agree with.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Day 5 (International Endless Zone Unlock)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Finally, one of these pirates dropped some booty!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I'm detecting something more challenging than treasure inside.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Look out. It's a map.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
To treasure! It says no zombies. Maps don't lie!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Well, we do have a shovel.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let's go! No time for precautions!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Hail fellow Captain,
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Be advised that your sailing vessel is of insufficient size.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Sincerely, Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Huh? What's that now?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We're gonna need a bigger boat.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Day 8 (International World Key Unlock, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
This will be most useful!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: With it we can access another World.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Nuts. I was hoping it would make our boat bigger.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Day 12 (Legacy Cannons Away I)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Target score activated. Let's see if you can beat my high score.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
And put in KRZYDV as your initials.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Day 14 (Legacy Save Our Seeds I)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Remember, protect those plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
And don't let those beans walk the plank!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Day 16 (Legacy Last Stand I)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
It's low tide and the waves are coming in.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Grab your water wings! We're going to get wet.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Day 25 (International Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
I've discovered a mysterious trait in your rattletrap time machine.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Its temporal signature is nearly identical to my own creations.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Explain to me, how was this "Penny" created in the first place?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Penny appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Could I really be some form of Zombot?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: User Dave, am I the daughter of Dr. Zomboss?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
That was one fine sandwich! So, what did I miss?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Day 25 (International Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Please, tell me about your creation process.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It was pretty easy! I found some timey wabby wabbo stuff.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Then I put it between two slices of bread...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: BOOM! Awesome sandwich!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
Such proliferous bunk. I should have expected as much.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I'll have the answers someday, when David's brains are on my plate.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
I'm ready to go. Pirates are great, but I think I'm getting homesick.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: No wait, I mean seasick.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Roll down the window, please.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: No time for that. There's a taco to find!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
These waves keep getting worse.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I'm still not wet.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I meant zombie waves.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
You've got a boat load of sun. Don't go overboard.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
I see what you did there.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wha -?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Why do birds suddenly appear?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Who cares? We have cannons and a score to beat.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Congratulations on beating my scores. I'm not bitter.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I'm not saying you cheated... cheater.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Yeah! Everyone's happy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Locked and Loaded II (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
CANNON FIGHT!!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Locked and Loaded III (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I feel like something is missing.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Sunflowers?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Nope. My taco.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Save Our Seeds II (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Those Spring Beans are living on the edge.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Danger is their middle name.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Someone should update the Almanac.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Pirate Seas - Save Our Seeds III (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
It is now clear that these beans are being stalked.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Leave no bean behind!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
Six shooters:\nlocked and loaded.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Old timey piano music:\ndownloaded.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Chance of taco:\n0.015%.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Margin of error:\n0.016%.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
It's a cattle drive...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: With plants...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And zombies!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Let's get these plants to the watering hole.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Isn't our goal to find tacos?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But that's a gold mine!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Day 3 (International Endless Zone Unlock)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
My Uncle Milo used to have one these, he called it a boom box.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Actually, that's close enough. I'll allow it.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Day 4 (Not OK Corral Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
It appears the zombies have been gathered in that corral.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: A not O.K. Corral!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Better plant something before they get loose.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Day 6 (Legacy Last Stand I)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
It's high noon, and waves of zombies about.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Time to show them who's got the fastest plants in time!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Like cow tipping, zombie tipping is best done from the side.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Trust me, do not try and tip a cow from behind!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Day 7 (Outro, Zombie Note Story)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
It appears brains are outlawed around here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Quick, neighbor. Play dumb.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We'll follow your lead, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Greetings Plant Rustler,
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Agents are arriving to mark your brains as my property.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Salutations, Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
I don't want my brains all marked up.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It took forever to get 'em clean.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Day 8 (International World Key Unlock, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Maybe we can use that to unlock our minds.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I still have some cleaning to do.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It would be better used gaining access to a World.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You know, for the greater good of....
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The Taco! I almost forgot.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Day 9 (Legacy Locked and Loaded I)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
These plants are mine.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Well not mine... yours.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They're for the mine...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: carts.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Day 16 (Legacy Save Our Seeds I)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
These levels can be tough nuts to crack.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
And I want to see the delicious creamy center.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The point is not to crack them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Day 25 (International Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Have you considered that you are sharing in Crazy David's madness?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: There is no zombie outbreak threatening you.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: You are not using plants to defend your home.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: The zombies and I are normal people, simply trying to help you.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
I bet you'll tell us there are no spoons, too!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Day 25 (International Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
That's right! These plants versus you and your zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And we didn't even use any spoons...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Even though those things totally exist!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave leaves.)
I admit you are correct in this regard.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: We have no existential conflict over the nature of spoons.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
User Dave, it's time to saddle up and leave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
There's a sunset. Let's ride!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Where do you think the future will take us?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: What has happened to the taco?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Why are cats hairy?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Just remember, Tomorrow is always a taco...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
User Dave, it's time to saddle up and leave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
There's a sunset. Let's ride!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Where do you think the future will take us?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The Future you say?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We should take another look at my Time-Space Taco Map.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
I could really go for a tub of fried chicken right now.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Well, they've let loose the birds of war, so you're in luck.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Nice job, Sheriff User Time Traveler.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
You've survived a lot of bull.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Not OK Corral I (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Put on your bloomers and charge your reeds.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This is a showdown!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Not OK Corral II (Legacy)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
That is a lot of mine carts.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
They're multiplying!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I didn't know mine carts could do math!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Not OK Corral III (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
My great grandpappy was a lawman around these parts.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Is that him over there?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Where?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Made you look.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Locked and Loaded II (Legacy)

lines.text: They're coming 'round the mountain for your brains!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Oh no, he's singing again.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Locked and Loaded III (Legacy)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
I can't believe there were so many chickens.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I cry fowl!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This will be remembered as the Great Chickening of 1850.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Save Our Seeds II (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
What's that sound in the distance?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
That is the sound of inevitability.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It sounds like a stampede of pianos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Wild West - Save Our Seeds III (Legacy)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Nice work.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
You've got the fastest fingers in the West.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Now let's make tracks!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
That looks like it could be all futurey.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I bet Future Dave has solved our taco paradox.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
I'm detecting a rush of tachyon particles.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Maybe Future Penny is trying to make contact.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Greetings temporal commuters.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: The future will be requesting your presence.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: But be aware...
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Upon entry, legal possession of your brains...
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Will be transferred to one Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Sincerely, Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
That Mr. Boss guy seems like a really nice fellow!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We should be wary of that one User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: In the meantime...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Earning stars will prepare you for Star Gates we find later!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Also, Endless Zones will keep you sharp for future trials.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Just remember, Tomorrow is always a taco...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Future! Weird, I thought I would be hungrier.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: After all I haven't eaten in 4000 years!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Hey, what happened to the lawn? It’s so glowy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I'm detecting an array of Power Tiles on the space-lawn.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 1 (Power Tile Tutorial Failure)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Whoa, better try that one again!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 3 (Legacy Sun Bombs I)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
You know how sometimes suns are bombs?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This is one of these times!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 4 (International Endless Zone Unlock)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I spy with my crazy eye a U.F.B.! An unidentified flying brain!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Something more formidable than a brain lies within.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 6 (Legacy Locked and Loaded I)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
You can pick your friends, but you can't pick these plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
But some of my best friends are plants!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 7 (International, Zombie Note Story)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
It says there's an error. Can you come here and fix it Penny?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Did you try unplugging it and plugging it back in?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Welcome back Gardener,
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: In this year your brains were collected ages ago.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Collect them again soon, Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Watch out neighbor, I'm pretty sure he wasn't talking about my BRAINS!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I would say there's evidence to the contrary.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 12 (Legacy Last Stand I)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I like to save some sun for a rainy day.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It can get you out of a pickle or into an E.M.Peach.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 15 (Legacy Save Our Seeds I)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Protect those Citrons!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It takes a lot of pulp to stand your ground like that.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 19 (Magnifying Grass Tutorial Failure)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Oops, you should give it another shot!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 19 (Legacy Locked and Loaded II, Magnifying Grass Tutorial)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Looks like we don't have much firepower here Penny.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
With a good supply of sun...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Magnifying Grass can pack quite the punch.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
You can decide to launch one mower early now.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Just press and hold a mower when the time is right.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Sometimes that's the most strate-logical thing to do!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 25 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Isn't it convenient that your neighbor is so helpful in your fight against us zombies?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Crazy David's apparent incompetence is only eclipsed by his usefulness.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: However, with one secret word my sleeper agent will turn against you.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Listen to me David, "Hypno-Zombnosis".
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Hey neighbor!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Can I borrow your brains? Um, I mean hot sauce!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Day 25 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Oh! That was...hypno-MAZING!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I want to eat THAT hypno-taco again! I need my TIME MACHINE!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: What? Wait a minute... what was I saying again?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave leaves.)
Hypno-Zombnosis... Hypno-ZOMBNOSIS!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Drats, or was it Zombno-Hypsosis?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Level 4 Zombie Introduction (Basic Zombie)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Hmph, my latest Level 4 Basic Zombie is finally here. With your limited intellect, you'd never think to upgrade your plants to Level 4 to deal with it!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)

dialogues.title: Far Future - Level 4 Zombie Introduction (Explorer Zombie)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Hmph, my latest Level 4 Explorer Zombie is finally here. With your limited intellect, you'd never think to upgrade your plants to Level 4 to deal with it!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Whoa there! Who dimmed the lights?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
No one, User Dave. We have simply arrived in the Dark Ages.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Sounds gloomy to me.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Indeed. According to my research, a plague has swept this era.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Also, sun no longer falls from the sky.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: What we need is someone to brighten this place up!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I got it! We need Sun-shrooms!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: These guys not only know how to turn a frown upside down...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They make more sun as they grow! Great guys, very talented.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Damn it! The lights are so dim here that I can't even see where the tacos are.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
There is a bright light in front, which seems to be a group of small glowing mushrooms.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let's go over there and ask, maybe they'll know where to get some good tacos.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I think you have to make sure they don't get eaten by something first.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny and Crazy Dave appear.)
Data suggests the Dark Ages were a time of intellectual decline and moral confusion.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Perhaps now is a good time to call upon the persuasive powers of the Hypno-shroom?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Good idea, Penny! We'll convert the wicked - Dark Ages style!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Deploy this shroom and the zombies won't know what bit them...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Until they see that it was their fellow zombies! Then, mind BLOWN!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I'm afraid the Dark Ages are giving me a bad case of the vapours.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, the vapours are no longer considered a real ailment.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But I believe Fume-shroom will be of use here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: His vapors are quite real and provide a distinct advantage against the right zombie opponents.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Fume-tastic! Let's give the zombies a case of the vapours instead!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Dark Ages - Night 9 (Intro, Evil Potions Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Warning! I've detected carafes containing chemical compounds of a malevolent makeup!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Can you translate that into Crazy Dave Talk for me?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: There are evil potions on the lawn!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Evil medieval potions! They're the most dangerous kind...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: On account of having twice the evil!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Dark Ages - Night 9 (International, Outro, Zombie Note Story)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
User Dave, we have encountered a scroll.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I love side-scrollers! They're my second favorite kind of game.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This is not a game. It's a piece of parchment bearing a message.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Will ya look at that! It's Dark Ages email. Neat-o!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Well met, Not-Very-Noble Lord!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: It is my fervent medical opinion that your humours are out of balance!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Methinks the siphoning of thine brains is the only way to correct this ailment!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Fare thee ill, Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Hey! I prefer my humors and my brains unbalanced!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Because I'm CRAAAAZY!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Why would anyone go and stick a nice sword into a dirty ol' rock?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I understand it to be a test, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Only someone with great physical strength and strength of character may remove it.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I bet someone with a jackhammer could remove it.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: A CRAAAZY someone!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: An inelegant but no doubt effective solution to the test, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Boy, Pea-shooter and Wall-nut sure are good at what they do.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Talk about two great plants that fight great together!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave! Perhaps you are not as cerebrally unsound as you periodically insist!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: What if there was one plant that behaved like both a Pea-shooter AND a Wall-nut?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We would call it a... Pea-nut!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Two plant powers in one legume's body?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Keep talkin' like that and people are going to call you Crazy Penny!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Which would be weird for both of us.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
According to my data, iron and other metals were routinely put to use during the Dark Ages.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Thus, Magnet-shroom should make an excellent ally here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: He can pull buckets, helmets and other metal objects off of zombies!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Some people think it's magic. But really, it's just physics.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Dark Ages - Night 20 (International Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
A question for you, my Ignoble Foes!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Hast thou noted how violent thine plants become upon consuming Plant Food?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Perchance, hast thou wondered what Plant Food is truly made of?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Verily, I shall tell thee. It's zombies! Plant food is made out of zombies!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Unpossible! We feed our plants only the highest quality organic uhm...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Hey Penny, what is Plant Food made of?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I fear the true nature of Plant Food requires further analysis, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Excuse me while I run some tests.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Dark Ages - Night 20 (International Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I have found no evidence that Plant Food contains zombies or zombie byproducts.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Phew! Plants shouldn't eat zombies who eat plants.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Except Chomper. He has to. Dude needs the fiber.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
Why dost thine time-traveling jalopy lie to thee?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Perchance, a question best left for another day?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Now, I pray, imagine maniacal laughter as I depart.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)

dialogues.title: Dark Ages - Night 15 (Legacy, Tit for Tat Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Looks like we're surrounded?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I think your Hypno-shroom friends can help you!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It is said that these costumed Hypno-shrooms have even more powerful power!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They are suitable for use where there are powerful opponents!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Forward, Hypno-shrooms!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 1 (Lily Pad Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Look at this beeeeautiful beach!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's got everything a growing plant needs!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Sun, sand and lots o' water!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Caution, User Dave. My sensors indicate there are zombies on your beach...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: ... and far too much water. It will overwhelm the plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: No problem-o! We'll just lay down some Lily Pads.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Then the other plants can ride the waves!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Or as the vernacular of this era goes: They can "hang ten."
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Right on, Penny, Right on!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
User Dave, data suggests that we should beware the tides.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
When the tide comes in, it'll be a WIPE OUT for our plant friends?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Indeed. But the tide line indicates how high the water will rise. Plan accordingly.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The tide comes in, the tide goes out. Who can explain it?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That would be science, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 3 (International, Chomper Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
When fighting zombies from the deep...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: ...we need a plant with the appetite of a shark.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I catch your drift, Penny. You're talking about Chomper!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Indeed. His sharp teeth could turn the tide of battle.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hey, I have an idea too! We could call this Chomper Week!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: If we must, User Dave. If we must.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I tell ya, Penny, these surf-loving zombies are the pits!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Analyzing the phrase: "The pits"...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hmmm. Pits. Very interesting. User Dave! You are a genius!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I am?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: No. No you are not. However, you have given me an idea.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Guacodile! This plant fights zombies with pit-like projectiles.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: And he employs a powerful bite as well.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Plant him on the front lines. You'll see.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 8 (International, Bowling Bulb Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
My research indicates that the sport of bowling experienced a heyday during this era.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Are you thinking what I'm thinking, Penny?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I find your thought process indecipherable, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I was thinking that Bowling Bulbs would make excellent allies here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Huh, I was thinking how much I love wearing bowling shoes.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: So many colors... right there on my feet!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 15 (International, Zombie Note Story)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Look! It must be time to play Beach Zombie Bungo!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Bingo, User Dave. It's BINGO.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You already won, Penny? Wow. You're good at this!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 16 (International Gargantuar Level)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Dudes, like, you're totally in for it now!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: The Deep Sea Gargantuars have their slimy sights on you.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: You can run! You can swim!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: But you can't escape their scaly grip!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Ugh. That dude is totally gnarly.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: He is also quite unpleasant, User Dave. Quite unpleasant.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 20 (International Endless Zone Unlock)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Alert! I've detected a strange statue of surfing-era significance.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Well lookie there! It's a tiki statue. With crazy eyes.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Analysis indicates this tiki could inflict a terrifying challenge upon any who follow it.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: So you're saying that a tiki torture awaits? Get it? A tiki TORCH-er?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, I must say, your pun is...\nTORCH-er-ous.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 21 (International, Homing Thistle Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Whew! Fighting Zombies that arrive in waves AND tides isn't easy.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: You know what we need, Penny? An ally with a lot of 'tude!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And by 'tude, I mean attitude. In case you need translation.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Then I suggest we call upon Homing Thistle.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I believe he has this 'tude you speak of.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: His eyes! intense! He can shoot the zombies a real mean look.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: More importantly, he can shoot deadly darts that home in on their target.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Two painful blows for the price of one! Radical!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 23 (International, Banana Launcher Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
User Dave. Please note the line of Banana Launchers.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They appear to need our protection!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let's get to it! After all, bananas are a very a-PEELING fruit!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave. If I had a head, I would be shaking it right now.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 32 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Yo beach bums! Don't flip your lid.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: But have you noticed that Chomper and Bikini Zombie have been ultra cozy lately?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Could a beachside plant-zombie romance be in bloom?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Speaking of which, how sure are you of Chomper's loyalties?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I can't help but notice... that plant has the appetite of a zombie.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Chew on that land lovers! Later dudes!\nDr. Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
A plant-zombie romance? Penny... my mind is BLOWN!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, do not jump to conclusions. I suggest something more productive.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let us jump into the action!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Big Wave Beach - Day 32 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
A plant-zombie romance? That's just craaaazy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And I know a thing or two about craaaazy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I concur. I suspect Dr. Zomboss was attempting to sow seeds of discontent.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: From now on, we are the only ones sowing seeds around here!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
Totally bogus! Little do you know what I have in store for you!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: The seeds of destruction have been planted! Brace yourselves for a wipe out!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: But for now, I gotta split. Catch you dweebs later!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Listen up, dudes! I'm here to totally bum you out.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Way down deep, there's a certain creep...
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: When he swims up, your brains he'll keep!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Later losers! Doc Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
That dude is totally gnarly.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: He is also quite unpleasant, User Dave. Quite unpleasant.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Brrrrr. It's colder than a polar bear eating an ice pop!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Indeed. It appears we have arrived in the Frostbite Caves.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We've traveled so far back in history ... we've arrived in PREhistory!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: A historic moment indeed, User Dave. But more importantly...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: My sensors indicate there is an ice floe on the lawn.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Data suggests it will block both plants and zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Though I predict hungry zombies will find a way around it.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Don't worry. We'll plant wisely and stop those zombies COLD!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Don't look now, Penny, but those plants have a bad case of freezer burn!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's the freezing winds from this time period. They've immobilized the plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I suggest we call on Hot Potato. She can melt those ice blocks.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I'm warming up to the idea already!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
My data suggests Hurrikale would be of great use here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: A blast of air from him, and the zombies will chill out and slow down!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The guy's a real blow hard. And I mean that in the nicest way possible.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
W-w-warning, User Dave! I am r-r-running l-l-low on antifreeze!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: If my systems f-f-f-freeeze up, we could be stuck here forever!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It'll be a cold day in heck before I let that happen, Penny!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Time to unleash Fire Peashooter!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: She can apply heat to those zombies, and warm up nearby pals too!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Frostbite Caves - Day 7 (International, Power Flame Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Global cooling is the pits. What we need is a heat wave!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Agreed. Please note, I have now replaced the snowballs with fireballs.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The Flamethrower power-up melts frost and damages zombies too.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Neat-o! You know, they say revenge is a dish best served cold.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But I say it's best served hot. Fiery hot! With extra hot sauce.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And a side of tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
These Cave Zombies sure are hard headed.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They just won't take "no brains" for an answer.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: According to my data, Neanderthal zombie skulls are 33.2 percent harder than other zombie skulls.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I propose we deploy Chard Guard. He has a secret up his leaves.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You mean his ol' Knock 'Em Dead maneuver?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It'll knock those zombies back where they came from!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I guess it's not a secret any more, now is it User Dave?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Me Zomboss. Me write you another threatening note.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: You in trouble. Biiiiig trouble. Gargantuan trouble, in fact!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Sloth Gargantuar smash! Smash your tiny, shivering plants!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Sloth Gargantuar deliver prehistoric plague of Imps!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Have bad day. Sincerely, Dr. Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
I postulate evolution will never come to that zombie.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Not in a million, billion, gazillion years.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Frostbite Caves - Day 15 (International, Zombie Note Story)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Penny, hath you ever tried licking an ice-thickle and got your tongue thtuck to it?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
No, User Dave. I have not.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Uh... me neither. Thath would be craaaazthy.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Sigh. While your tongue heals, please note the strange stone tablet.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It appears to be a warning sign, written in Cave Zombie.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Doesth it warn people not to lick ice-thickles?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I wish these prehistoric zombies would just go back to their caves.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, perhaps it's time to try a new tactic.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Data suggests Stunion would make for a... potent... ally here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Great idea, Penny! That guy's breath is stunning!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Not even exaggerating. He stuns zombies... with his bad breath.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Gross. But also, pretty nifty!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I'm starting to get cold feet about this place.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Also, my feet are getting really cold.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Time to turn up the heat. I recommend Pepper-pult for the job.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: He lobs hot peppers at zombies and also keeps nearby plants warm.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let's pick a peck of Pepper-pults! It's the perfect plant for our predicament!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Must you rhyme, User Dave? Must you?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Frostbite Caves - Day 20 (International Endless Zone Unlock)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
User Dave, I've detected an incoming ice cube.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Looks like a zombie-sicle to me.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Analysis suggests this creepy cube unlocks a chilly challenge.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You know what I say? Brrrrr-ing it on!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Frostbite Caves - Day 25 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Gurrreetings! Dr. Zomboss have prehistoric question for pitiful plant friends.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Why you hunt for taco? Is taco all it cracked up to be?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Could it be... trap? Could it be... trick?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Chew on that! Mwwwahahaha unga unga!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Penny ... my taco!?!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, ignore the taco. Ignore the taunts.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It's time to FIGHT DR. ZOMBOSS!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Frostbite Caves - Day 25 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Well done. We have defeated Dr. Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: And his attempt to make me question my taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, our journey through time...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You know that it is about more than just a taco.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I suppose you're right, Penny. It's also about-
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
Ha! Dr. Zomboss not defeated!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Dr. Zomboss crawl back from brink of destruction!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Dr. Zomboss return when you no expect him. Bring BIG SURPRISE!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Dr. Zomboss stop speaking about self in third-person now! Guuudbye!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Penny, what we need right now is a nice hot cup o' cocoa!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, that is an unproven zombie-fighting weapon.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I recommend we call on Rotobaga instead.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: She can hover above ground AND shoot at zombies in four directions!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Kid's got talent! Maybe she knows how to make hot cocoa too?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
It's too quiet. Where is everyone? I have a bad feeling about this.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: My sensors indicate there are zombies hiding under the ice.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I know this game! They call it Hide & Eat Brains.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Time for a game of our own: I call it Whack-A-Zombie.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Whack them good and they will surely drop better hammers.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I'm sorry. Can't help it. Have to say it. It's ... hammer time.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Woah! Welcome to the jungle!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, this is no ordinary jungle. A scan of my records indicated that this is the fabled Lost City.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Historical texts state that the Sun was worshipped here. Resources should be plentiful.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I suggest that we try planting on the Gold Tiles that we find here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They should continuously generate sun as long as they have plants on them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Lost City? This is it Penny! We've found it!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Where else would I find my lost taco, except in a Lost City?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Your continued fixation defies all logic or reason, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
My sensors indicate movement incoming from above.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Maybe it's presents. Presents from the sky!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The chances of that statement being true are statistically irrelevant.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I believe it to be a new form of zombie threat. We should be cautious of unexpected guests.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
We are facing considerable threats, User Dave. I suggest that we retaliate with tremendous force.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: More forceful! That's it! We'll give them all a stern talking to.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I was referring to the Lava Guava. Its explosive blasts leave behind dangerous magma.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That sounds even better! First a stern talking, then some lava!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Caution, User Dave. I detect a zombie with a shovel.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Can he dig it?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It appears to block incoming shots. We need a way to get projectiles over the shovel.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I know! TELEKINESIS!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try again, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Lost City - Day 15 (International, Zombie Note Story)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Well lookie-here, Penny! It's a treasure map!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: My analysis suggests that the origins of that map are highly suspect.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It has a big red X on it, Penny. When have big red Xs ever been bad?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Come here seeking adventure, have you?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Unfortunately for you, the Porter Gargantuars are about to ruin your day!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: They carry imps. Imps! Prepare to become ancient history!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I wish someone would carry me around in a tiny house!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I wish for a lot of things, User Dave. That is not one of them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss, Crazy Dave, and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Lost City - Day 17 (International, Imp Porter Zombie Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Alert, User Dave! My sensors sense incoming Imp Porters.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Importers? Of fine goods and glassware?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Negative. They pitch tents on Gold Tiles, and the tents spawn zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Imps with bad inTENTs!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Beware, User Dave! I detect trap tiles.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They are triggered by zombies, or when you plant on them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: And then they give you taco?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: If you equate tacos with jets of flame and huge boulders, then yes.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Lost City - Day 20 (International Endless Zone Unlock)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Look, Penny! A shiny doo-jickey-ma-thing!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: My sensors indicate this amulet points the way to a long-lost challenge.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let's do some deft discovering!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Lost City - Day 32 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Do not think to usurp our discovery of the fabled Lost City!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I and my zombies have already submitted our find to the Eminent Journal of the Missing and the Mislaid!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: We will publish and you will PERISH!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)

dialogues.title: Lost City - Day 32 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
All that discovering and still no taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The search will no doubt continue, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
My discovery remains intact. The taco is still unfound. And your brains will certainly one day be mine!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Flashback! I remember this décor from when I chased squirbos as a kid!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Indeed, User Dave. We appeared to have arrived in the midst of a Neon Mixtape Tour.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I suspect the musical tempo may affect the zombies' speeds.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I'm feeding the rhythm, I'M FEEDING THE RHYTHM!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Caution, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I believe special zombies may display unique abilities while their preferred music is playing.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You mean they'll jam their jam when their jam is jamming?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Yes, correct, yes, and yes, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I got a real Cactus feeling about this, Penny!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Indeed, Cactus has changed over time, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Now she fires a thorn for ranged damage, but hides for ground damage when zombies approach.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's so Cactus... always varying her attack and defensive profiles!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Neon Mixtape Tour - Day 14 (International, Zombie Note Story)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Somebody passed me a note in homeroom, Penny!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It says to meet behind the bike racks at lunchtime for a funderful surprise!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I believe some skepticism about this note is in order, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Neon Mixtape Tour - Day 16 (International Gargantuar Level)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Do you feel that you have grooved? Did you bang your head? Have you "dug it"?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Now the party is over! Melt before the musical might of my majestic Hair Metal Gargantuar!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I'm scared, Penny! It's two minutes to midnight!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Be brave, User Dave. We'll jilt this ditty... on rock and roll!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss, Crazy Dave, and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Neon Mixtape Tour - Day 17 (International, Garlic and Breakdancer Zombie Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Mmm! Penny, do you smell something scrum-dicious?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: No, User Dave. Only Breakdancer Zombie.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Maybe they're garlic-flavored!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
