dialogues.title: Neon Mixtape Tour - Day 20 (International Endless Zone Unlock)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Penny! Penny! Penny! A microphone!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Karaoke time! At last my tangerine dreams will come true!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Caution, User Dave. This dropped mic promises a banned battle of heavy petal proportions!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Neon Mixtape Tour - Day 22 (International, Spore-shroom Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Spore-shrooms have a unique ability, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: If they defeat a zombie, a new Spore-shroom will spawn where that zombie fell.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hey-wah-zoo! Spore-shrooms mean more shrooms!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Neon Mixtape Tour - Day 26 (International, Intensive Carrot Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Say, Penny, do you think Intensive Carrots can be used to revive defeated plants?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's... that's exactly correct, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Sorry. It just confuses me when pay attention.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Neon Mixtape Tour - Day 25 (International Day 32, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Hmmmm... you're in danger above. You're a fool; and so knew I!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Hear me now: Ever shall you give up; ever shall you be down; always you'll run aground, I'll revert you.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I intend to make you cry: I mean for you to say goodbye: I'm not really that nice a guy - I alert you!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Ouch!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Neon Mixtape Tour - Day 25 (International Day 32, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Yarbs! That was close... with so many exciting timing and rhythm changes!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I fear we have only hit pause on Dr. Zomboss's heinous deal.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
Indeed, next verse, same and yet worse! I go now to when you cannot imagine!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Alert, User Dave. My sensors indicate we have moved 153,954,765 years into the past.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Yabbers! That's before I was even born!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Correct. We seem to have landed in some form of Jurassic Marsh.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I knew I smelled more oxygen!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
This epoch is known for its unusual lifeforms, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I know! Gymnosperms, right?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I was thinking more in terms of saurians, User Dave. Dinosaurs.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They won't attack us directly and we can't affect them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: However, they will definitely react to zombies. Be wary!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 4 (International Day 6, Stegosaurus Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I can feel the ground a-trembling, Penny! More dinos?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Indeed, User Dave. A herd of stegosaurs approaches.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: My sensors indicate they will snare zombies with their tail, and then flick them off.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's what I would do!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 6 (International Day 9, Pterodactyl Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Penny! I just remembered how much I love silent letters!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Coincidentally, User Dave, a flock of Pterodactyls is approaching.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Pterodactyls? That's ptotally pterrific!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 9 (International Day 8, Perfume-shroom Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I have analyzed a new plant, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The Perfume-shroom charms dinosaurs and turns them against the zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Dino-sour power? On OUR side? This is taco-level great news!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 10 (International Day 21, Jurassic Bully Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Beware the Jurassic Bully zombies, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They are immune to the Primal Peashooter's knockback effect.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Zuh? But how? Even Gargantuars get knocked back!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: True, User Dave. The Bully is simply too stupid to observe typical physics.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 11 (International Day 16, Gargantuar Level, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Surrender your brains forthwith, inane time stumblers!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Else you shall share the fate of these terrible thunder lizards: EXTINCTION!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
But I don't want to get extincted!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 11 (International Day 15, Outro, Zombie Note Story)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Look, Penny! A fresh star-hunky!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: A meteorite. Curious. My records indicate this should be... bigger.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Bigger? Like, super burrito-sized?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: More like super Seattle-sized. I hope history has not gone awry...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 14 (International Day 17, Primal Sunflower Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
...sigh...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: What troubles you, User Dave?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I just always wanted a primitive sunflower who gave big suns!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Prepare for satisfaction, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 20 (International Endless Zone Unlock)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I see a toenail! Of unusual size!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This raptor claw bespeaks an ancient arena of dinosaurian dimensions, User Dave!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I detect Primal Potato Mines nearby, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Their prepaleolithic potency will far exceed our more refined modern versions.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: BASHED Potatoes? I love them already!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 25 (International Day 32, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
My infuriation is epochal!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Is there nowhen I may go to avoid your imbecilic interference?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Stay right where you are. I have an enormous rock scheduled to make your acquaintance.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
I just hate a ticking rock!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Jurassic Marsh - Day 25 (International Day 32, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I detect an incoming meteor, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I advise immediate egress from this timezone.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Bye-bye, dinos! You'll be birdies in no time!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
Bah! You leave me no choice but to enact... Project Paradox!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I will perceive you soon, fools!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Aha! Project Paradox begins...NOW!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Timeline alert, User Dave!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We have arrived moments before our departure!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: If my guess is correct, Dr. Zomboss will attempt to prevent your initial taco-consumption!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Our journeys will cease to exist!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: NOOOOOOOOOO!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: ...OOOOOOOO! Sorry, I was busy screaming "No." Did you say "taco"?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We must beware, User Dave. Dr. Zomboss will surely deploy all his time-varied zombies against us!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: TACOOOOOOO!!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Moonflower emits sun, User Dave. But that is not all.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: My scans show that it creates a special glow that augments plants of its type.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Planting Moonflowers next to each other should increase their power.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I suspect they will have the same effect on any other shadow plants we may find.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: TACOOOOOOOO!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Shrinking Violet is well named, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It shrinks zombies and makes them weaker.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Tiny zombies! Stay away from my shins!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Nightshade is another shadow plant, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: By itself it deals slapping damage to zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But if it is planted next a Moonflower, both will become more powerful.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Botanical buddies? That's CRAAA-ZY!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I am picking up a grid of plants, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: My scans suggest that they can be swapped to create matches of three.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I saw a game like that once on my telephoney!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
My sensors are picking up increased helium levels, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I suspect we may be facing one or more Balloon Zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I hate one or more Balloon Zombies!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
We have picked up a Shadow-shroom seed packet, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Shadow-shrooms are shadow plants, so be sure to plant them next to Moonflowers for bonus effects.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Adjacency wins again!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Look, Penny! MY TACO!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: No, User Dave! You must not! I detect high levels of trappiness!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But...HUNGY...CHOW...TACO!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Fools! You have fallen into my excruciatingly obvious trap!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: My vast and varied array of Gargantuars will pummel you into total oblivion!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
And then I get my taco?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 17 (International, Dusk Lobber Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Dusk Lobber is yet another shadow plant, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: On its own, it lobs exploding projectiles.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: In its powered state, however, it lobs down three lanes!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's a lane for each of my thumbs and noses!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 19 (International, Escape Root Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Escape Root is a tricky plant, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: When threatened, it swaps in an explosive plant!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: And if you tap it, and then another plant, they will switch places!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You can use Escape Roots to rescue endangered plants!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Whaaaaa-? Plants can be in-dangered? CALL THE POLICE!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 20 (International Endless Zone Unlock)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Penny! A random length of sewer pipe!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Be careful, User Dave. That pipe is part of a municipal mulch of endless engagement!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 21 (International, All-Star Zombie Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
All-Star Zombies are encroaching, User Dave!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They tackle and destroy the first plant they encounter!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I blame the ref!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Oy howdy! I think it's one of those Beghouled-y grids again, Penny!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Grimrose is a shadow plant, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It drags down a zombie that enters its lane.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: When powered, it can dispose of three zombies before it expires.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That just seems like it's trying too hard!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I hear tiny feet! They're pitter-pattering!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Engage caution, User Dave. I detect Super-fan Imps ahead!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Their team spirit is explosive!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 25 (International Day 32, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
It is presently a moment of your apocalypse!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Your reckless pursuit of an already-eaten taco has shattered all of time!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: It falls to me to restore future, now, and past!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Can it be true, User Dave?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Has our quest ruptured the timestream itself?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Allow me to address your concern thusly:
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: *ahem*
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: TACOOOOOOO!!!!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 25 (International Day 32, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Fools! Do you not value the validity of time?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Care you not if one moment follows another?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Moron! Ignoramus! Pot-wearer!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
It's not a pot, it's a handled basin!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I am concerned, User Dave. What if he speaks true?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I'm too taco-addled to care, Penny! FORWARD!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 26 (International Day 33, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
I beseech you, time-zippers, you must listen to reason!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Coherence crumbles! Our eras become nonsensical!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Stuff is all jiggy and super wacked-out, like!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
RELEASE THE SQUIRBOS!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 26 (International Day 33, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
I am telling the truth, Insane Dave Person!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: My words are utterly not an attempt to trick you!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: You cannot re-eat a taco! It is impossible!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Imp-possible? I HATE IMPS! WITH A PASSION!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 27 (International Day 34, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
If you will not listen, then you will be destroyed!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
You have no credibility! TACOOOO!!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day - Day 27 (International Day 34, Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
David, I implore you! You must give up your hopeless dream of a long-ago taco!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: It is gone, gone forever! But please, in its place, take this!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Is that...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It can't be...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: A TACO WITH A WAFFLE IN IT!!!!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I detect high levels of deliciousness, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: THIS IS THE GREATEST DAY IN MY OR ANYBODY ELSE'S LIFE!!!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Indeed, perhaps we have misjudged Dr. Zomboss all this time...
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
Ha ha ha! Perhaps you HAVE misjudged me. Or... perhaps not!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I surely have no devious plans for the future! Or... do I?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Bwah-ha-ha-haaaah! We shall meet again!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Ah, this is the Kongfu World. I want to see the qigong performances!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: According to my calculation, the danger level of the zombies that know Kongfu doubles.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Also, be careful of those weapon stands. It looks like the zombies particularly like taking stuff off the stands!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Why are there zombies carrying bombs in the Kongfu World?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Because the detector discovered there are a lot of explosives here. Be careful of the flammable lines.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: If I plant Iceberg Lettuces on the whole lawn, then that'll be crazy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The detector detected a spacetime black hole forming!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Oh no! All of our plants would get sucked in!

Black holes, I hate black holes in space and time!

lines.text: I know, but there are still many weapon stands to deal with!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

Hey, hey, I want to learn the nunchaku!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Data shows a huge wave of Kongfu Zombies is approaching.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: No worries, our Kongfu plants are even crazier than they are!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

The Kongfu World zombies here have been cleared.

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I believe that in the near future, more powerful Kongfu World zombies will appear. Let's go!

I hate those weapon stands with torches!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Here, the prologue of the ultimate challenge opens again.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Wait, why is it "again"?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
I believe it wasn't the slip of your tongue.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Start it soon, before the player can't wait any longer.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hey, is that strange guy our opponent?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Don't be nonsensical, he could have eaten the tacos in the opposite room.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Oh, tacos I'm coming!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I heard that using ice plants can put out fires!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Make sure you have enough Iceburg Lettuce or Snow Pea plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Wow, these burning leads are driving me crazy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Data shows that Dave needs a Winter Melon to be satisfied.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Kongfu World - Spacetime Black Hole I (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Analysis shows that the roots of Resistant Radish are very deep, so they can resist the absorption of black holes.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I know, but my Resistant Radish is missing!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Kongfu World - Spacetime Black Hole II (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The detector shows that the threat level of spacetime black holes is increasing.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I will never eat tacos again, I want Resistant Radish!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Kongfu World - Spacetime Black Hole III (Legacy)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Warning, the largest black hole so far appears ahead.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Don't be afraid, my Resistant Radish has already eaten Plant Food!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Woah! Where is this! I feel like I'm about to be blown away!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The data shows that we are at an altitude of 11,045 metres.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You might find something special here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But I'm afraid of heights! Aaaaa!! I have to go inside first, besides there won't be anything at such a high place.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The detector doesn't think so.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
The main gun can automatically attack zombies, or it can activate skills to cause a lot of damage to zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
The main gun skill takes time to accumulate energy, so please use it with caution.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Fly, fly, fly!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We have equipped the plants with aircraft that allow them to conduct air combat training.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Select a squad for training.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Ha! You've chosen the bravest plant squad and mastered the art of piloting the aircraft!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Once you earn enough points, your plants will automatically level up!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's time to show off your real skills!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Sky City - Day 10 (Hard Mode; Legacy Air Raid II, Flying Gargantuar Introduction)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Time for a close encounter with a Gargantuar! Just one touch and... I almost let that slip. Anyway, enjoy yourselves! Ha ha!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Be careful! Don't let the aircraft come into contact with the Gargantuars!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
There seems to be something wrong with the spaceship.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I extended the deck of the ship.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Now I can go into the cabin to make repairs!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Dear neighbor! Help me guard the entrance to the cabin, don't let zombies come in and cause trouble!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It is said that King Zombie is developing a flying car and is collecting parts from everywhere.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Don't let zombies steal our parts!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Sky City - Removing an Across the Lawn Wooden Box

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Hey! You've mastered the art of wielding a shovel like a sledgehammer!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Don't worry about these details!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Sky City - Across the Lawn Wooden Box Introduction

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Penny found some boxes.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Let's see what we can do with it.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Sky City - Across the Lawn Wooden Box Defense

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Well done!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Look! The route of zombie attack has changed.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Use boxes to stop zombie attacks!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Then plant your defenses and fortify the lawn against the zombie horde!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Only flying plants can be planted in the sky area outside the deck.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

The durability of the spaceship will decrease when it is attacked. When the durability is exhausted, the game will fail. Please protect your spaceship.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Thunder! Plants, be careful with lightning. Being hit by two lightning bolts in a row will cause different damage!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Please follow the arrow prompts to plant.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Steam Ages - Day 1 (Steam Manhole and Flat-shroom Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Woah! Where is this place? My stomach is growling again!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Welcomes to the Steam Ages! This is the 14th stop of this time travel.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: What a strange smell! The smoke coming out of these holes doesn't smell as good as the food!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Data shows that toxic steam will be emerging from these holes and cause damage to the plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Ahhhhh!! These holes are bottomless! It makes me afraid of heights!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It is said that the depth of this cave reaches the 6666 metres.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Perhaps if you look at it for a while, something will come out of it.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: There must be nothing in that cave! Who would live in a cave that deep!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But our detector doesn't think so.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Use Flat-shrooms to block these holes temporarily from emitting toxic steam and zombies from coming out.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Steam Ages - Day 3 (Gentleman Zombie and Fanilla Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
There's a guy who is as gentleman as me!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This is the Gentleman Zombie of the Steam Ages.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hey! It seems that I can becomes friends with him!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The Gentleman Zombie will cross the shielding plants and damage the plants behind them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Use Fanilla to blow away Gentleman Zombie's umbrella to make him unable to perform his special skills.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
There's so many guys with parts in their hands! Are they working hard?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Of course not, these should be zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Where's the kitchen? I wanna see if there's any delicious food!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I wonder if there's a kitchen! But you need a powerful shooter to attack these zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Lotus Root is a powerful long-ranged plant in the Steam Ages. It can not only absord the toxic steam, but also cause damage the zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I have trypophobia! So many holes!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The detector shows that plants or zombies will emerge from the holes.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Is there a spring bed in the cave?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This one doesn't.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Using this hammer, hitting zombies will give points, and hitting plants will deduct points. When you reach a certain score, you can pass the level.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You can get double hammers by spending gold coins, which you can get double points by hitting zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Spend diamonds to get double hammers with no mistakes, which you can get double points by hitting zombies or even plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Is there a guy over there with a boiler on his back trying to lose some weight?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's a Furnace Zombie that will explode after a while.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let me ask him if he can carry such a heavy thing without getting tired?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Theoretically he won't feel tired.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Use icy plants to delay the explosion time of the zombie.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Steam Ages - Day 21 (Coal Miner Zombie Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
There's a guy pushing a cart! There's definitely a lot of snacks over there!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The data shows that it's a Coal Miner Zombie.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Huh? Don't those black ones look like ink tacos? New varieties?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: These are no ink tacos but coal that buries zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Use fiery plants to burn the coal!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Steam Ages - Day 24 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Long time no see, fuzzball, rusty contraption, oh, and you!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: It's no easy to come here, is it?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: In order to repay your efforts, let you experience the power of technology in the industrial era!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
What kinda zombie is he... Oh, Dr. Zomboss!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Oh Dave, I have to make the necessary reminder that he is Dr. Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Maybe we should take a look at how long he can last this time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Steam Ages - Day 24 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
You thought you won, right?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: But you don't know that something terrible is happening!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Mwwahahahaa continue to immerse in the joy of victory, soon, you will see some "new things" !
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
What he said is quite bluffing, ahahahah.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Perhaps he really is researching something terrible, we should be careful.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Renaissance Ages - Day 1 (Vitruvian Wheel and Wax Gourd Guard Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Woah! This looks like a place a lot full of tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Welcome to the new space and time journey! This is Europe in the 13th century, full of literary and artistic atmosphere.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The detector shows that we are in a museum.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Look at those guys' collars, they look like tacos, maybe they like tacos too!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I don't know if they like tacos or not, but they definitely like brains the most.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Look! What are those round things? Ugh! New tacos I guess?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's the Vitruvian Wheel. If you use the wheel wisely, it will become a secret weapon against the zombies!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wax Gourd Guards can help us use our secret weapons.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: What are those arrows on the ground? It's as if it says there are tacos ahead!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The arrows on the ground determine the rolling direction of the wheel.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Renaissance Ages - Day 3 (Aloe and Perfume Zombie Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Oooohh my God!!! The mist here almost makes it hard for me to open my eyes!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Our detector shows that this mist is poisonous, be careful!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Look at that bottle that chap's holding in hand, it can't be a taco-flavoured drink!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's the Perfume Zombie, the bottle in hand can create poisonous mists that will cause damage to the plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: This damn poisonous mist! I'm almost suffocating!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We need a plant that can purify this poisonous mist!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Aloe can purify the poisonous mist created by the perfumer and increase the plants' attack powers.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Renaissance Ages - Day 5 (Aristocrat Zombie Statue Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I saw lots of incredible statues, it was pretty interesting! Ha ha!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Oh! Look at those stone statues!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This is reaaally interesting ahaha!! I bet they stole the tacos!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Those are zombie statues, they turn into real zombies at night, we have to smash them during the day!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Watch out of the nightfall.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Renaissance Ages - Day 7 (Sculptor Imp Zombie Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Hey! What is the guy who looks like he's carving there doing?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's the Sculptor Zombie, it can carve raw stones into zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Sounds fun, I believe I have a talent for sculpting too!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Data shows that your talent reduces the success rate by 99.999%.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Destroying the rough stone in advance can prevent the Sculptor Zombie from carving out zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Renaissance Ages - Day 14 (Oily Olive and Ballet Zombie Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Those pals are wearing weird clothes and they can't even walk properly! I bet they were drunk!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Those are Ballerina Zombies, they always appear in groups of four.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: What a horrific setup, do four people need to share a same taco? If that's the case, I'd rather appear alone....
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Use Oily Olive to stop fast-moving Ballerina Zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Oh! Look at those stone statues!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Those are zombie statues, they turn into real zombies at night, we have to use tools to deal with them during the day!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: This is reaaally interesting ahaha!! I bet they stole the tacos!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Note that the number of tools is limited.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Renaissance Ages - Day 25 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Intro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
O madman, can the plants thou hast sown halt the wheel of fate?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I shall turn thy garden into a realm of zombies.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: But first, let us begin a grand performance!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
I didn't understand a word.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: He said he was going to kill you.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Maybe he has tacos on him.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Renaissance Ages - Day 25 (Dr. Zomboss Battle, Outro)

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Alas, fate! Fate!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: My efforts have passed like a meteor streaking across the heavens.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Ye revel in fleeting pleasures, unaware that I shall return like lightning!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
I still didn't understand a word.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Perhaps this is a "Shakespearean" poetic defeat.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Heian Ages - Day 1 (Sun Saisen Box Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Woah! This looks like a place with lots of wasabi tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Welcome to the new spacetime journey! This is Japan in the 10th century, the Heian Ages.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The detector shows that we are at a shrine near Mount Fuji.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Look at those guys' hairstyles, they look like tacos, maybe they have tacos hidden in their hairs!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: According to the scan analysis, there are no tacos hidden under their hairs. And they are wearing wigs.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Look! What is that box over there? Ugh! Taco box I guess?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's the Saisen Box. Use different saisen boxes rationally, it will help you deal with the zombies better!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Of course you have to "put coins" in there first. Oh, I mean your Plant Food.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Sun Saisen Box returns some sun to plants planted nearby.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Heian Ages - Day 2 (Firework Zombie and Dripping Diphylleia Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Oh my God!! They are holding a smokestack chimney in their hands, and it's also set on fire!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Warning, those are Firework Zombies, the fireworks they spray will set us on fire!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wo! This hot feeling, did they add chili sauce in it?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The water droplets of Dripping Diphylleia can extinguish the fire from the fireworks.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: What are you waiting for?? Hurry up!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Heian Ages - Day 3 (Plant Food Saisen Box Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Oh! This is an unusual saisen box, will it contain tacos this time?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Pay attention to the emblem on the saisen box, this is a Plant Food Saisen Box, which allows nearby plants to release their Plant Food effects altogether.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Heian Ages - Day 4 (Plant Saisen Box Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Are there any other boxes? I wish there was a box for tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Dear Dave, forget the tacos for a moment. This is the Plant Box.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It can provide you with a high-tier plant to help you deal with powerful zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Heian Ages - Day 5 (Stephania and Ninjimp Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
These guys have a whole lot of stuff! Is this a gift?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Please be careful! Those are Ninjimps, and they are holding alive pufferfish!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: What do these guys want? I bet they were tryna steal my tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The probability of this possibility is 0.01%. At the same time, data shows that they are experts in sneak attacks.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But we have Splitting Stephania, who is an expert in dealing with these kinds of ninjas.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Heian Ages - Day 6 (Upgrade Saisen Box Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Welp, another different box. There's no tacos in there anyways.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Yes, this is an Upgrade Box, which will upgrade nearby plants and zombies by one tier, please use it with caution.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Heian Ages - Day 7 (Chef Cypripedium and Sushi Zombie Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Hey! Do you smell anything? Tacos are 10,000 times better than this!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Dave, I don't even have a nose, and secondly, that's a Sushi Chef Zombie, he makes pretty delicious sushis,
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: which makes zombies that crave it more challenging.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: However, Cypripedium Chef is an excellent chef and is eager to have a gourmet showdown with these sushi chefs.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Perhaps we should get out of the way.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Should I ask him to make me some tacos?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Heian Ages - Day 11 (Heian Divine Wind and Dendrobium Windbreak Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Wohoo! What a strong wind! I feel like I'm about to be blown!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: According to the data, strong winds often hit this place, which may also be accompanied by terrible tornadoes.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: This has a huge impact on us.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wow! Can we fight the forces of the nature?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Please use Dendrobium Windbreak, as they can block the tornadoes and prevent plants from being blown away when planted together.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They can also unite to increase their powers.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Look at them, they are wearing hats and holding cans, what are they doing?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: After scanning, it's the Mino Zombies, whose hats can defend against projectiles,
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: and the fish baskets can absorb energy beans.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Aha! Can't we just attack them from the front then?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Those guys are wearing weirdly strange clothes and are holding fans in their hands!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I bet they are heating hot!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Those are Onmyoji Zombies, and they holding Tengu's fan. Legend has it that this fan can attract strong winds.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That would really make everyone feel cooler!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Submarine mode on... 100%.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: User Dave, data shows that we are about to go to the underwater ruins that were submerged ten thousand years ago.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Underwater ruins, lost tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We are always looking for those lost things, right!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The detector shows that underwater zombies have been constantly searching for the brain.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: User Dave, we have to get ready!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I'll prepare the dryer, water-soaked tacos don't taste good.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Be careful, there is more than one outsider in this sea!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: So can swimming really help you lose weight?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
Uh, don't worry about these details…
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
There seems to be something outside the submarine.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Detected Mollusca, Cephalopod, Cryptozoa, Sepia, Sepidae, Sepia genus organisms.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Their ink is not easy to handle, so be careful!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: This time it's seafood tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Stars, are we in space?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Detected that it's not a real star, it's a starfish.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The frightened starfish spins around and hits the submarine, speeding up the water flow.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I'm already starting to faint.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I know, jellyfish!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It can squeeze out jellyfish paste.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The water content of jellyfish is as high as 95% to 98%. I don't think jellyfish sauce can be squeezed out.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Frightened jellyfish will take away our plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Jellyfish sauce!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Is that a magical conch? Can it answer my question?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The probability of hearing the answer is 0%, and the probability of hearing User Dave's scream is 100%.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Zombies like to decorate their heads with hermit crabs to make their heads safer!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I think I know the origin of the roadblock.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Warning! Sensor detects increased water flow.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: User Dave, we need to prepare a response plan.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Turn off the sensor!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Every time I see a Pufferfish, I always want to poke it.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I suggest you drop this idea, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Loose balloons flew everywhere, and so did the pufferfish.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I love balloons!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Some powerful beings have emerged.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I also want the jellyfish to catch me and swim.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This is probably not a good idea, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The zombies are attacking more and more fiercely.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: This may mean we are getting closer to our destination.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I'm beginning to miss life on land.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
What are those fish with pointy mouths?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They are swordfish, the fastest fish in the ocean.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Because they swim too fast, be careful they hit the deck of the submarine.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Did we insure the submarine?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Can this leaky circuit full of soaked pickles really withstand the pressure of deep water?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: What a pity! I've already finished your stupid underwater adventure one step ahead!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: The relic zombies flying in the sea will crush your dreams! Your remains will become part of the ruins and buried forever!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Will you live in the underwater ruins forever? It would be great if there was a sauna under the sea.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Seeing is believing, User Dave, we will personally uncover the secrets of the ruins.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss, Crazy Dave, and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Underwater World - Day 13 (Whale and Puffy Derris Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
User Dave, we finally successfully arrived at the underwater ruins.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Please be careful, these blue whales accompanying us now have huge appetites.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Dive into such a deep sea just to find food?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It would be great if the Puffy Derris could curb your appetite too.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Data shows that these Relic Zombies seem to be passing judgment on outsiders.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We have never been ticketed for exceeding the speed of light every day!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
My analyzer needs more information on these underwater Relic Zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Please complete the virtual experiment according to the operating rules and help my analyzer draw conclusions.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The functions of the props in the upper prop bar from left to right are:
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: 1. Upgrade to enhance the quality of brain cake and speed up the growth of zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: 2. Upgrade to increase the number of brain cakes that can be fed at the same time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: 3. Upgrade to enhance the damage of attacking invasive fish.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: 4. Unlock new zombie types.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: 5. After purchasing, the brain cake placed next time will be turned into sushi. The purpose is not yet clear.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: 6. Purchase three trophies to complete this level.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
What are those on the seabed?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Molluscs, protect themselves with shells.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Like an iron pot on my head!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The data shows that their opening and closing power seems to be very strong.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
What are those black thorny balls?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Echinodermata, Echinoidea, Echinoidea.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Looks like it's perfect for scrubbing!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Plants don't think so, Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Underwater World - Day 18 (Colossal Hermit Crab Introduction)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
These zombies seem to want to start an underwater battle with beasts.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Never drag a cat along!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Cats hate water, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Beast fighting activities are still going on, and more weird creatures are about to appear.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Data shows that they seem to come from the terrifying underwater abyss.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I didn't sleep for 15 years, staring into the abyss.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Yes.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The detector still needs more data!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Please continue to complete further simulation experiments!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Moon’s surface is terrible! There’s no way to plant anything here!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: We can try planting on the Moss Tiles.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Great! Is there any way to make more Moss Tiles?
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try planting Cosmoss next to the existing Moss Tiles.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I just realized—we planted those plants without spending any Sun!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: Correct. Plants are now powered by the Life Support System, so they no longer require Sun.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Each plant increases the electrical load on the Life Support System.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave appears.)
A zombie horde is coming! Let me help you plant a few!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Stop planting! The Life Support System has entered Buffer Overload, and the plants are becoming unstable!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hmm-hmm-hmm~ (didn’t hear her)
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Huh? I can’t plant anything, and the plants look like they’ve stopped moving.
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: That’s because the Life Support System has entered Super Overload! We need to find a way to increase its maximum power capacity!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Try using a Collector! It can mine crystals to increase the system’s maximum power capacity!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Great! Everything is finally back to normal!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Now get ready for the next challenge.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Cosmic plants can be planted directly on the Moon’s surface without the help of Cosmoss.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wait! Sound can’t travel through a vacuum, so why can I still hear those zombies going "RAAARGH"?
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: Wait! I can go "RAAARGH" too!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: I equipped you with invisible earbuds that simulate battlefield sound effects in real time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Can you switch them to taco-munching sounds?
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
A rocket has been detected ahead.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: A rocket! I’ve already buckled up!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Cosmic Pea, Cosmic Nut, and Cosmic Mushroom each trigger a different effect when launched aboard a rocket.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Liftoff!!!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Those zombies have shiny things on them! They must be sale stickers!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: Analysis indicates that they are Teleportation Beacons.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Once critically injured zombies retreat, they will return through the beacons at full health. Disintegrating them with Cosmic plants can prevent the beacons from being deployed.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: So we’ve gotta make them disappear without a trace—not even leave a return address!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Alert! A Radioactive Meteorite is approaching!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Space delivery? I didn’t order a glowing rock!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
The Radioactive Meteorite will continue contaminating the surrounding tiles. Deploy a Collector to mine it as soon as possible.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Mining complete. The Radioactive Meteorite has permanently increased our power capacity.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: So it wasn’t a bad rock after all—it just made a rather rude landing!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Moon BaseZ - Day 13 (Hard-Shell Crystal Vein Introduction)

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
What’s that strange chunk of ore?
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: That’s Hard-Shell Ore! We can only mine the crystal inside after breaking through its hard shell!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Plant more plants and break that shell!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Moon BaseZ - Day 14 (Fragile Crystal Vein Introduction)

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Beep beep! Fragile Crystal Vein detected!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Do we have to break this one too?
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: No! Fragile Crystal Veins will shatter after being mined for a while, and can’t be mined anymore once they do.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Some Fragile Crystal Veins contain Plant Food, which you can collect after the crystal vein shatters.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: All right! Guess I can’t mine to my heart’s content!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
What’s that giant magnet up ahead?
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: That’s a Gravity Generator! It can alter gravity within its target area!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The magnet fires purple Anti-Gravity projectiles. When they land, units in the target area enter an Anti-Gravity state.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Plants will keep floating upward, while zombies will rise and move forward.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Oh, I don’t like floating around!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: Time for Gravitree to take over! Gravitree can remove the Anti-Gravity state.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The magnet also fires green Hypergravity projectiles. When they land, units in the target area enter a Hypergravity state.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Plants will sink into the ground, while zombies become immune to knockback.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Stuck in the ground? Why does that sound like a zombie thing?
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: Plant Cosmic Saucer! Cosmic Saucer can remove the Hypergravity state!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Use these two plants wisely to counter the Gravity Generator!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Looks easy enough! Let’s get this battle started!
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Moon BaseZ - Day 20 (Radioactive Crystal Vein Introduction)

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Danger! Radioactive Crystal Vein detected ahead!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Radioactive Crystal Veins periodically irradiate nearby plants and zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Plants will randomly transform into other plants, while zombies have a chance to transform into Cosmic Radiation Gargantuars.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Then what would I turn into if I went over there?
lines.speaker: Astronaut Crazy Dave

lines.text: Uh, I don’t know, but you’d better not try it.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Astronaut Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 1: Pinch Pennies

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Data shows that excessive use of sun can anger the deity of the Sun.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wow! I don't want him to go on strike!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 2: Full-On Firepower

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Cob Cannon wants to compete with Coconut Cannon.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I guess you want to try coconut-flavored popcorn.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 3: All-Out Counterstrike

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Data indicates that the tombstone on the lawn is cursed.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wow! Then I have to study them carefully!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's best not to destroy them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 4: Mechanical Surge

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Welcome to my new product launch conference.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Z-Mech 2.0 will forcefully acquire your brains on my behalf!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Enjoy the rest of your time!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
I want to file for bankruptcy protection.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, we did not purchase brain insurance.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 5: Assault from the Clouds

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Why is the sky so dark?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: A large number of airborne zombies detected. They will launch an air raid, descending like a torrential downpour.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: How did they get up there?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 6: Evacuation Drill

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Rotobaga can fire projectiles in 4 directions at the same time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: More suitable for attacking zombies in adjacent rows than facing them head-on.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Like early morning tacos.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Every side is grilled to perfection!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: So delicious!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I want to eat ten!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 7: Backup Power

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Where has the sun gone?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Data shows that now is the best time to dispatch backup low-energy weapons.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Watch out for the glowing zombies carrying seed packets.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 8: Survival of the Fittest

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Robo-Cone Zombie must have really strong teeth.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Information shows that Chef Cypripedium's cuisine remains popular until the Far Future.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Maybe it will help with the taco cooking.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 9: Remembrance of Earth's Past

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
What's all the commotion on the lawn?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's the dinosaurs. Data shows that they once ruled this land.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Are we in the Jurassic Period now?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
We're surrounded!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Fortunately, we have Escape Root, which can swap places with other plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It can move them out of danger, or put them in position to counter the right opponent in time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Can it take me to find tacos?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 11: The Dark Forest

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Data shows that Dr. Zomboss invented a special zombie that feeds on sun.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: So zombies don't need to eat brains anymore?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I don't think so, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 12: Natural Selection

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Data shows that chickens and Tyrannosaurus rex have a common ancestor.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: No wonder they are always so grumpy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Wow! The big one among them is here!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 13: Death's End

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Guard-gantuar is so tenacious!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Data shows that Guard-gantuar has extremely high damage reduction.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We need to control it to find the weak points.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 14: Swift as the Wind and Quick as Lightning

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
A large number of hungry zombies have been detected moving towards us at high speed.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Should we give way to them?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Better stop them, otherwise we will face a serious traffic accident.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 15: Snowbound Companion

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
User Dave, please don't stand between two Icy Currants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The ice tunnels they create can make you sluggish, turn blue, and get a bad cold.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Oh... oh... ah sneeze——!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 27 - Level 16: Haunting Eve

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Scarecrows are supposed to keep birds away.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But why are they gathering more and more?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Information shows that Halloween is here, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Heh heh! Trick or brain!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave, Penny, and Dr. Zomboss leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 1: Heavy-Nucleus Fission

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Some heavyweight friends have quietly joined us on the lawn.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Doom-shroom possesses terrifying new powers. I cannot determine whether he came from the past.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: His powers are so great that they may even tear apart space and time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 2: Celestial Storm

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Many magics and miracles are born from living in harmony with the forces of nature.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: People and seeds, seeds and gardens, plants and celestial bodies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wow, that "miracle" will definitely happen to the zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 3: Meteoric Destruction

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Alert! Something is falling in the sky.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Oh! It's the fireworks from the cosmic party that have arrived.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It will summon meteorites to attack zombies, like smashing peanut shells with the Milky Way.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Don't forget that Lunisolar Honeysuckle can manually switch attack attributes.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 4: Spectacular Finale

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Meteor? magic? Doom-shroom? This power does not belong to you!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Before everything gets out of control, I'm going to deprive you of your thinking brain!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Large-scale offensive detected, it is recommended to use banishment magic.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It's time for the "curtain call."
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 5: Doomsday Judgment

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Warning! Uncontrolled fission supercritical detected.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: After Doom-shroom explodes, he will randomly spread spores to divide it.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We need to protect the split products in time to obtain more experimental data.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 6: Total Freeze

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
So cold! The plants on the lawn were frozen.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We experienced a very rapid and abnormal cooling.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Recommended to use red snow suit, sled, and Hot Potato.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 7: Under the Spotlight

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The zombies invited us to "a dance battle across the ages."
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's a code phrase. It means:
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: "Dance till you're drained, in body and brain; zombies move in, your brains they will gain!"
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 8: Universal Gravitation

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Wow, the Winter Games have come to our front yard!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Ice track cleared. Skating waltz downloaded.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Venue rule announced: No metal objects allowed!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
The opening ceremony is over, and the warm-up is complete. I declare the Winter Games open!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave, Penny, and Dr. Zomboss leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 9: Advance or Fall Behind

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Bungee Zombies have secretly moved our flower beds.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They intend to use them to demand brains as a ransom.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I think I finally understand what it means to fear breaking the vase while trying to hit the rat.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 10: Dazzling Display

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
If we arrange the magic mirrors in the right way, they can form a closed loop,
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: creating a maze that zombies can never escape.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Then how do we get the zombies trapped inside?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 11: Spacetime Chaos

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Strange, Sunflower sleeps during the day and Repeater spits out cabbage...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's just snowed, but the front yard is burning hot.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The collapse of space and time has been detected, and the real world we live in is disintegrating for unknown reasons.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's too scary, we should hide on the roof!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 12: Last-Ditch Battle

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The zombies have also climbed onto the roof.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The cause of the collapse was discovered. Many past timelines were damaged and urgently needed to be repaired.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's time to go! But it will take some time for time travel to recharge.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: A new adventure! But let's clear the roof first.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 13: Blazing Heart

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Current time: Late 17th century. A major battle with pirates is imminent.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wind direction: Northeast. Wind speed: 54 knots.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hot oil, loaded... Furious sailors, all in position!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Everything is ready. It's time to launch a fire attack.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 14: Impossible to Guard Against

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The atmosphere is not quite right.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We are about to experience a frenetic gold rush showdown in the late 19th century in the West.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wow! Get on the minecart quickly, load the peas, and find cover!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 15: Raging Azure Tide

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Penny, the protracted war and the endless winter have made me a little tired.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I miss summer, the sun and the beach!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: No problem! We traveled back in time to a certain seaside vacation.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Now we just need to fight off some uninvited guests that shouldn't exist.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 28 - Level 16: Treading Frost, Solid Ice

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Hey! How to catch a scurrying mouse?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: 1. Traveling to the "future."
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: 2. Follow along the paw prints.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: 3. Travel back to the "past" and lay a trap!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
We are plunged into the longest and harshest winter in history.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Then can spring be far behind?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 1: The Wicked Wolf Advances

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Wow, we're back! It's a new year again!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Detected a familiar evil force trying to prevent us from successfully celebrating the New Year.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I saw it! It's the large Nutcracker left over from Christmas that pounces on me.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 2: Asteroid Belt

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
How could I have a dream about the New Year?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's the reality we're experiencing now in the correct post-repair timeline.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We encounter a huge "meteorite" ahead, we must return to modern times as soon as possible!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Why do they look so like bronze men?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 3: Angry Crow Takes Flight

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The zombies even brought out Halloween props.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Airspace invasion warning, aviation formation attacks.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Mission: Annihilate enemy planes, enemy zombies, and enemy crows!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 4: Tornado Destroys the Parking Lot

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Welcome to Fatal Chase Racing!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: As long as you are still standing on the ground, my ultimate flying zombie will hunt you forever!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
Maybe we can't stay on the ground anymore.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But I can't fly.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
