dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 5: Projectile Motion

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Zombies are gathering, and there is a 120% chance of a sandbag-throwing fight in the front yard.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let me catch them and throw them back!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 6: New Frontier

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The zombies invite us to an exciting auto-chess showdown!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I guess we have no choice but to play the plant side.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 7: Repel Enemies from Afar

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
It was too crowded on the deck, so I moved the potato mines to the side.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's not a good idea. Once it explodes, our ship will leak.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We must not let the Swashbuckler Zombies successfully board the ship!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 8: All Forms Shine Together

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I have prepared gunpowder for the New Year fireworks show and need an all-around security guard.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: As the saying goes, one has too many skills to overcome one's problems, let the zombies experience the bond of the Pea family!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 9: Cliffside Defense

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I have an ominous feeling, we have been here before!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I hope you won't be careless in the same place.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Don't worry, I brought my tacos this time.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 10: Hands and Feet Tied

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The evil magic circle has taken over our lawn!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This is a mysterious ritual that summons a spacetime black hole.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Maybe we can use it to crack this formation.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 11: Dragon Ridge Shakes the Wilds

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
We traveled back to the farthest past in our journey.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: There are about 150 million years left before successfully entering 2026.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It feels like there's not much time left, but it seems like there's a lot of time.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 12: Time Bomb

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The zombies also got the powder keg, and they wanted to use the explosion to blow open the door.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hoho! It seems they didn't know they were escorting dangerous goods.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's a real time bomb for them!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 13: Paphiana Jones

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The mysterious tent will constantly spit out various zombies like a four-dimensional pocket!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Please let Pocket Paph take out some wonderful props from your pocket and lend them to us.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 14: Nip It in the Bud

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
There are about 2.85 million years left before 2026!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The Ring Time Paradox prohibits us from using plants harvested after we left here.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But it seems to be colder here than before we came here.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 15: Take Aim

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
According to the history of artichoke cultivation in ancient Egypt, we are only about 4,000 years away from modern times!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: There are no zombies here, just a bunch of strange camels.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This is an ambush, no disguise can deceive the eyes of the dart master.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 29 - Level 16: Kings, Generals, and Ministers

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Burdened by 365 days of worries, brains can find their final resting place only in the night.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Abandon your hopes for tomorrow, and give up on ever reaching the New Year!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear; Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
But I still want new tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: If we get lost in the past, we will lose the possibility of a future!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 1: Electromagnetic Induction

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Magnet-shroom pulls in metal, and Electric Peashooter fries zombies in one shot—does that count as electromagnetic induction?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Strictly speaking, electromagnetic induction is when a changing magnetic field generates an electric current. I'm surprised—you actually know physics?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I don't. I just think crispy zombies look pretty appetizing.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 2: Blend of Ice and Fire

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Data shows that attacking frozen zombies with fire causes increased damage.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Because it makes them catch a cold more easily?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: That's one factor we can't deny, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 3: Propulsion Motion

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Data indicates that this childhood-style yard makes these Imps more active than usual.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Get these Imps out of my yard!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I just planted those flowers!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 5: Drive the Tiger to Devour the Wolf

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
It's time for these zombies to try the fresh Shadow-shroom.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But if the zombies eat the Shadow-shroom, what do I eat?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: You may try the new taco flavor, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 6: Lure Zombies into Formation

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Our trap is almost complete.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's great! What materials are we still missing?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Data shows we still need… $8.99.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 7: All-In Gamble

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
It appears the Armageddon is near. Our resources are critically low—no sun, no buffs.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We still have some secret weapons that can wipe out zombies over a large area. Time to bring them out.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Everything depends on this. If we fail to eliminate the zombies under these conditions, our brains will be eaten.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 8: Using Zombies Against Zombies

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Warning! A huge wave of zombies detected! And we did not bring Sunflowers!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Good thing I invited a new friend—he'll fight alongside us.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 9: Mystery of the Foggy City

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
No one knows what lies within the fog. We may lose our way.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Luckily, we've brought along an assistant to a famous detective. He can guide us.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You mean… these Pea-nuts?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 10: Counter Violence with Explosions

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
A huge wave of zombies is approaching—plant Explode-O-Nuts and blow them away!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Warning: Explode-O-Nuts have limited range. Are you sure zombies won't counter the explosions with violence?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Blow up one, that's a win; blow up a bunch, that's profit! Let's take the fight to the zombie horde!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 11: Fight Through the Sky

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Legend says that when Onmyoji Zombie waves its fan, the shrine is swept by powerful winds.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: All I know is, when Levitater flaps its wings, zombies start flying.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: If these two winds meet, will they sweep up pufferfish?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 12: Body of a Titan

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Why are there so many warning lines on the lawn?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Zombie Commander appears.)
Alarm Arrowheads in the same lane will form a warning line.
lines.speaker: Zombie Commander

lines.text: Once triggered, one side of the Alarm Arrowheads will activate immediately.
lines.speaker: Zombie Commander

lines.text: It not only deals massive damage, but also disables nearby machines.
lines.speaker: Zombie Commander

lines.text: Those Hot Dates will lure zombies in, leaving them mesmerized for quite some time before they snap out of it.
lines.speaker: Zombie Commander

lines.text: I see… wait, who are you?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Zombie Commander leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 13: Strike from the Side

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Explode-O-Nut and Hot Date can't do anything against Explorer and Excavator Zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, wait until they ignite, then move the minecart—that's called riding the flames to wipe them all out.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The zombies are practically roasted already—time to roll out a full-on barbecue party!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 14: No Room to Maneuver

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
We've returned to the first stop of our journey, but this time it won't be as easy.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The circular time paradox prevents us from using plants obtained after leaving the initial maze map.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: No room left to maneuver—let's clear this quickly and move on to the next stop.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 15: Endless Bouncing

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Aren't those the beans the zombies used to target?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Protect them—Leave no bean behind.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They've grown used to danger. So have we.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 30 - Level 16: Raging Winds

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
The fierce winds have arrived—let Sky City become your grave.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Behold—My newly developed Elite Lightning Gun Zombie will crush every plant in its path!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Strong winds out here—careful your big talk doesn't blow back on you.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Activating emergency protocol: send these zombies back to the ground!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss, Crazy Dave, and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 1: Gargantuar Crisis

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Have you ever wondered what it would be like if every zombie were a Gargantuar?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You don't think they'd be interested in my taco, do you?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, they're only interested in smashing plants, not your taco.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's a relief... wait, no, that's even worse!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 2: First Movement

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The zombies have challenged us to another dance battle.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They said, "Losers have to crawl into a crater and hide."
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Curse detected! Defeated zombies will actually leave craters behind.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 3: Target Number One

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Those Sunflowers are sending out SOS signals!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We've arrived at the birthplace of plant rescue missions.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: If we fail this mission, history will be changed forever.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 5: Three Feet of Ice

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
As the saying goes, three feet of ice isn't formed in a single day.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Do you think these zombies have been frozen since the Ice Age?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Perhaps we should be more concerned about becoming popsicles ourselves.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 6: Cleansing Flames

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
When those flame trap tiles activate, it looks like an outdoor barbecue.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The keys to cooking zombies are timing, temperature, and not setting yourself on fire.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 7: Renovation Project

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I need to complete my collection of Gargantuar trophies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: You can use those zombie transformation devices. All you need is patience while waiting for volunteers.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 8: Sporting Spectacle

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
How dare you hold a sporting event under the very eyes of the great Roman zombie legion!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: The destroyers of the Olympics shall make you pay for your insolence!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I have a feeling we're about to witness some very passionate crowd participation.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 9: Turning Foes into Friends

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Will hypnotized zombies still damage the flower beds?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: No, and they'll even become helpful allies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's great! I love watching zombies fight each other.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 10: Icy Guardian

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Our sun system has been hacked. We can only hold up to 50 sun.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Sounds like it's time for our new friend to shine!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Don't forget to bring Plantern. The zombies seem to have gained the ability to turn invisible.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 11: Journey Toward the End

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Guacodiles are waiting in the protected zone, ready to depart.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Those Guacodiles are important to us. Don't let the zombies reach them, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Then let's make sure this Guacodile Express isn't its last ride!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 12: Gate of the Netherworld

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
This Underground Palace is dark and damp. What kind of plants would actually like it here?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Based on the environment, I believe we'll soon receive some unexpected reinforcements.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 13: Clash of Light and Shadow

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I have a bad feeling about this. The zombies have received an epic power boost.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Shadow plants possess tremendous potential. Plan your sun economy and firepower distribution carefully.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let's complete this legendary challenge together!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 14: Night Without Mushrooms

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Where did all the mushrooms go?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Looks like we'll have to rely on these Oak Archers.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: These marksmen only know how to do one thing: shoot targets they can see!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 15: Lamb to the Slaughter

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Have you ever wondered who drew that treasure map?
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Now the true treasure hunters have come to claim their prize!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Whenever there's an X marked on the ground, treasure must be nearby.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave, we've been tricked. We're the treasure!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss, Crazy Dave, and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 31 - Level 16: It Takes Two

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
One plant is all I need to deal with those zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Unknown signal detected, User Dave!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Arrogant fool, I shall cast thee from thy saddle!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: What he said was pretty intimidating.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Perhaps he really is working on something terrifying. We should be careful.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave, Penny, and Dr. Zomboss leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 2: Cold as Frost

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Abnormal spacetime fluctuations detected. The front yard is shaking violently.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We can only deploy a small number of elite plants at a time to quell the chaos.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I recommend this "seasoned ice-industry veteran," an expert in the tactical philosophy of winning with fewer forces.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 3: Icy Wind and Flame Shadow

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Icy Currant’s encirclement is as cold as the netherworld itself.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: User Dave is detected to be chilled to the bone. I recommend using Zhong Kui Lycoris to warm up.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Its netherworld flames can set one’s very spirit ablaze.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 4: High-Energy Alert

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Attention! Plants standing on an exposed rooftop during a thunderstorm are much more likely to get struck by lightning.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Don’t ask why zombies aren’t.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: Sincerely, Dr. "Insulator" Zomboss.
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 5: Multiplication Plan

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Ever wanted to use holographic technology to project something even better than Wall-nuts?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Take this Pineclone! Just toss it onto your strongest plant!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Then sit back and enjoy the barrage!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 6: Between the Tides

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I found a message in a bottle. The letter inside says:
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: "You are cordially invited to meet us at sea. Signed... Not the Zombies."
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Let me stuff this reply inside:
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: "If you’ve got the guts, come ashore!"
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 7: Perfect Partners

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Have you ever heard the legend of Medusa?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: If you accidentally meet her gaze, you’ll be turned to stone.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We happen to have a "Plant Medusa" of our own.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Perhaps she can help us deal with a lot of troublesome zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 8: No Takebacks

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Sun is precious! Every planting decision must be made with care.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Put the shovel away, Neighbor. We need to nurture our seeds with care.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Think it through, prepare the Flower Pots, and don’t forget to water them on time.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 9: Live Off the Enemy

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The zombies from Dark Ages are extremely powerful, and our firepower here is limited.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: A head-on fight would be extremely difficult. We’ll need a special strategy.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Maybe we can get the resources we need from the enemy.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 10: Cowboy on the Run

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Warning! A herd of enraged bulls has been detected!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They’re charging toward us while chasing a huge crowd of zombies!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Is it time for Spain’s Running of the Bulls or something?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 11: Enemy at the Gates

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Shh! We’ve run into the vanguard of the zombie archaeological corps.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We need to be careful. Deploying too many plants at once will attract the main zombie force.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We need to stay quiet... and make them disappear into the jungle.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 12: Sidestep the Onslaught

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Eggplant Ninja can hold back an entire army just by standing there.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Once given mobility, it can dodge incoming attacks while pulling off advanced attacks of its own.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Swiping the minecart around is an art form too. Take it away, Neighbor!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 13: Floating City

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Lily Pads have been washed away by the waves!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Our aerial forces over the sea are about to arrive. Prepare for airdrop.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That aircraft looks kinda familiar...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 14: Hanging by a Thread

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Corrosive acid rain encountered! We only have those Tulip Trumpeters available.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We need to find a way to get them into their healing form.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: As the saying goes, a crisis can awaken one’s will to survive—and plants are no different.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 15: Disaster from Above

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Deck’s gone! Full speed ahead!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Now, aside from Seagull Zombies and Swashbuckler Zombies, there shouldn’t be any zombies capable of catching up with us!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: According to the records, seagulls aren’t the only things that can fly... and Swashbucklers aren’t the only ones who know how to use ropes.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Memory Lane Season 32 - Level 16: Mutual Destruction

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Sit back down on the bench! My epic production will show you the true meaning of art!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: A tragedy of love and sacrifice, brains and destruction—let the curtain rise!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I think we’re the protagonists of this tragedy.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: A tragic ending of mutual destruction seems inevitable.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss, Crazy Dave, and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
It's another calm day, let's bask in the sun and fight zombies!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Warning: Abnormal fluctuations in spacetime energy, dangerous signal detected.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hey man, this happens all the time! Go go go go! Meet these Japanese samurai!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The instrument says... oh Dave... gone again.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
My head is so dizzy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We seem to have been transported to more than 10 years ago by the turbulence of space and time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The detector shows that the surrounding spacetime energy is even more chaotic.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: There is also a spacetime stabilizer in the trunk!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Those lingering zombies are here again, let me activate the spacetime stabilizer.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Look, this is a sign-in calendar for you. If you mark it every day, you will get rich rewards.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Oh, right! Take a look at the "Welfare". Penny has written a seven-day guide for you. You will be rewarded for completing this guide!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
You have collected enough stars by defeating zombies!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Open the Star Exchange and take a look, it contains what you need now!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
There are many rich rewards here, you need to clear the level and collect enough stars to redeem them!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Claim your rewards now and keep going!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
The zombies behind are getting stronger and stronger, I think you need some support.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Open these treasures and take a look, there may be plants among them that can help you!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Aha! Have you seen the power of those plants?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They can perform even better, try to find some costumes for them.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Looks like you've obtained a costume for your plant.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Put it on the plant, then try out its effects on the zombies!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: System Tutorial - Ancient Egypt Day 6 Guide

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
When plants wear costumes, their Plant Food effects will become more powerful.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try it now!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hey, did you see this piece of wood? His name is Travel Log.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: He will post some requests for your help every day, and of course there will be gifts in return.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: System Tutorial - Ancient Egypt Day 8 Guide

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave appear.)
Wow! You see, this place actually has a skull logo.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This sign indicates that terrible zombies will appear in this place. Be careful.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Look! You just got a pendant! Go try it out.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Now you've equipped your plant with a pendant. Perfect!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: By the way, congratulations! Turn to the last page of the travel brochure and see what rewards await!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Let's see the power of the upgraded plants!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
When plants unite, they have incredible power!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try to liberate their power in the plant family!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
The research and development of the new Artifact device is completed!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It's time to check it out!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Click this button!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hey! A zombie with an Artifact was found!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Without further ado, hurry up and grab it!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
Learn how to use plants and finally get 5 Level 4 plants, which can better fight against zombie invasion.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Great! The next plant master is you!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Kill the zombies in this level to get new artifacts.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This time, I will lend you the Kamikaze Artifact that I have half developed.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Evil zombies are invading us! Try challenging them!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
You already helped me find the taco here.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I think we can go find new flavors.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
After detection, some new worlds were discovered nearby.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: After comparison, the world danger coefficients of pirate style and western style are judged to be lower.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Emmm... I think we can start exploring from less dangerous places.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
In addition to guarding your garden, plants will also look for partners.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Go try sending them on an adventure! I believe there will be different gains.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Continue the challenge with upgraded plants!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
We discovered that this spacetime is actually connected to other parallel worlds!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Come here and take a look! You may have some different experiences.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
You should have a lot of plant fragments now, right?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: You can try in transgenics to make them more useful.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hello, Penny seems to have tracked Dr. Zomboss's signal. Come and have a look!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Hey! Isn't the problem here solved? Why did something happen again?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It must be because the zombies are not convinced, so they come back to challenge us with stronger strength.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hey! We have prepared some good things, and as long as you pay a small price, you will get rich rewards~
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny and Crazy Dave appear.)
There is actually a skull sign here! It must be very dangerous!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Maybe we should upgrade our plants to deal with more powerful zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Then what are we waiting for? Come and try it!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Let's try opening the legendary treasure!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The resources we saved before are enough for you to connect ten times at a time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Now you have enough plant puzzle pieces to upgrade your cactus!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
You know what would be helpful?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: A place where you can read about plants and zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
You mean like the interactive Almanac?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Nah, that would never work.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
I found some spare change.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Penny, you're finally makin' sense!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
I have a new discovery! When you access the time stream at the right moment, you can even adjust the spacetime hyperparticles.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I thought it was just a blinking zombie!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
This is called the Zombie Head Super Pliers.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I call it... Hey! sounds good!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
My program prohibits the use of foul language.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
You have some Power Ups! I'll show you how to use them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Yeah, and now we can break the seal. Let's get crazy!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
You can try out your Power Ups for free here!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
You already have enough stars to unlock plants!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
This thing must be exchangeable for something good at the plant-levelling page!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Most interestingly, there are special props there!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
That's amazing! As long as you pass more levels, you can get more plants!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
I found some more diamonds.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Penny, you are becoming more and more reliable!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Neighbor, take it! Don't ask why—you know what I mean!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
There are enough stars to redeem!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
There are enough stars to redeem!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
You have used up the number of draws today, please come again tomorrow!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
We reach the galaxy map and you can unlock one of the worlds.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I will choose the one with less pepper!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Attention! After each new world is unlocked, the number of stars required for the remaining new worlds that have not been unlocked will increase.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
There's still more levels in open worlds.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: And there are still plants and rewards to earn too.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Also, remember the taco!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: We haven't forgotten about you my dear lost taco.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
You've unlocked new costumes for your plants. Come take a look!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
You can check the costumes you own in the costume backpack.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: New costumes can also grant plants additional stat bonuses.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Penny seems to have tracked a mysterious signal, come and have a look with me!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
I'm tired of those familiar levels, can't there be some new tricks?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
I've done the yard, Dave, you can lay it out the way you like.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's awesome, Penny, so I can turn the yard into the level of my dreams.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Yes Dave, I've got the shovel and Flower Pots over, along with your favorite plants and seeds.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hey, Penny, I heard that there is a novel card game recently?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Yes, Dave, I've got it ready for you, I think you'll like it.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But why are there zombies besides my favorite plants?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Don't worry about the details, Dave, they're just cards.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Experts in plant cultivation from other worlds have sent a challenge. Do you want to take a look?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Of course! When it comes to growing plants, I won't lose to anyone!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Warning! warn! Mutant zombie detected!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Strange, where have we come? Is this still my backyard?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The location is confirmed, the current location is the Eastern Path to the West.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Oh, you know Penny, I still miss my backyard and it's time to get ready to go back.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
A new spacetime rift has appeared, and system analysis contains a new secret world that we have never explored.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: And the detector shows that there is a powerful collectible in the secret realm.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Would that be tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I don't think tacos would give off that much energy.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: This energy is enough to make us more comfortable when facing zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Why can't tacos! Heading towards the tacos!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Look, this is a sign-in calendar for you. If you mark it every day, you will get rich rewards.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Oh, right! The travel brochure has been opened, there are many newbie benefits, remember to check it out!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Slide your finger to drag the vehicle to move. The horizontal vehicle moves left and right, and the vertical vehicle moves up and down.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Please find a way to move the car and let me go home. The zombies outside are too scary!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(New Year Crazy Dave appears.)
Happy holidays! This is a holiday red envelope for you.
lines.speaker: New Year Crazy Dave

lines.text: Holiday red envelope!
lines.speaker: New Year Crazy Dave

lines.text: (New Year Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
There is an impending attack on your house in modern times!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I bet it's not an attack... I bet it's a party! Oh, I hope it's a Piñata Party!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's not a party, there are zombies from all different time periods ready to strike!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Who knows what else they could have brought with them?
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Sounds like a party to me! Better hurry up, we don't want to miss out!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
The party is over for now, but those zombies will be back some day.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
And with them... more piñatas!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Defending against multiple parties in a row could lead to a massive "piñata" anomaly.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I can't wait for the next Piñata Party, and the one after that!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But those piñatas just remind me of my sad lost taco. Let's go!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Penny appears.)
User Dave, this does not look like a party.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
It could still be a surprise party, with gifts and everything!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: You'll see Penny, I think these zombies are different.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
What did I tell you Penny? A surprise Piñata Party!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Does not compute. It appears a level 3 diagnostic check is in order.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Piñatas! Let's bust some open and see what we get!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
You are truly amazing! Most deserving of the name... Señor Piñata!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Have you seen my taco Señor Piñata? It was about this big...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
That's it. Please disrupt this anomaly before User Dave gets too attached.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Missing a "Piñata" Party will reset the build up to the massive "piñata" anomaly.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I won't pretend to understand why, but the data does not lie.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Just let us know of any more Piñata Parties you detect!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: For a party they can be pretty sneaky.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)

dialogues.title: Second Summer Night Piñata Party (Strawburst Introduction)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Tap the Strawburst to fire.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Strawburst's berry grows over time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)

dialogues.title: Lawn of Doom 2015 Piñata Party (Jack O' Lantern Introduction)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Tap Jack O' Lantern for a burst of flame.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Tap and HOLD for an extended burst that does increasing damage!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)

dialogues.title: Modern Day Part 2 Piñata Party (Escape Root Introduction)

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Tap the Escape Root, then tap another plant, to make them switch places.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Escape Root explodes when a zombie gets close.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
A lawn of vases is like a box of chocolates.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Some are awesome! Others taste downright ugly!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But all vases are much harder on your teeth!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Be careful with how fast you break vases.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You might end up with more ugly than you can handle.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Zen Garden - Sunflower Growth Speed-Up Tutorial

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Your Sunflower will grow up too, but it takes awhile.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Try some more Gems to speed her up!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Zen Garden isn't just for growing Marigolds.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: You can also grow mega powerful boosted plants!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But boosted plants only last for a single level!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Zen Garden - Marigold Growth Speed-Up Tutorial

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
If you wait a while, your Marigold will grow.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But you can speed up the process with Gems!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
I see you've found a sprout.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Maybe if you water it, you'll get coins?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: At least, I think that's how it works.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Penny! A grid of plants for swappin'!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Indeed, User Dave. Plants can be swapped to create matches of 3 or more.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You must make 125 matches to defeat the zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: You can use sun to upgrade your plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny and Crazy Dave appear.)
I detect three different Power-Ups, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They are Power Shuffle, Power Shovel, and Power Zap.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Power Shuffle scrambles the board if you are having trouble finding a match.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Power Shovel fills in a crater, allowing an eaten plant to be replaced.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Power Zap power zaps zombies.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I was confused about that last one!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
SO MUCH SWAPPING, PENNY!!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Indeed, it is a gauntlet, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: However, my sensors detect a rich reward if we persevere.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Keep calm and swap on!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Whew! That plant grid was rough like old sausage!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Correct, User Dave. However, we should expect a rich coin reward for our efforts.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Alert, User Dave! My batteries are losing power.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: But you need power to roll your windows up and down!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Correct. Perhaps some electrical plants can restore my charge.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: That's so plausible, it just might work!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny and Crazy Dave appear.)
My batteries are nearly charged, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Wahoo! So many electrons!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny and Crazy Dave appear.)
That Electric Currant is sparky AND sparkly!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Indeed, its electrical power is most invigorating.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It will make an excellent addition to our collection.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I have detected an Electric Currant plant, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Two in the same row or column will create an electric field between them.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The field will damage zombies and recharge my batteries.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: What a positive development!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I detect mine carts, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Use them to zap zombies with Electric Currant fields.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Watt a great idea!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
All this electricity makes my face-beard hurt! Can we stop for a beach break?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Of course, User Dave. Prepare for Beach Party onslaught.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Can we have bananas?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Bananas will be provided.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
How are your batteries, Penny?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: They are charging nicely, User Dave, thank you for inquiring.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: The Electric Currants are most helpful.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They sure make a powerful coulomb-ination!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Penny appears.)
Note the rolling boulders.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: When triggered they destroy plants and zombies alike.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Attention, User Dave! I have audio-detected a large stash of zombie gems.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Heard the horde's hoard, huh?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: If we move swiftly, we may be able to claim them for our own.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hi-ho-Gem-Jam, awaaaaay!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Those gems are so close I can smell 'em!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Like gooseberries in springtime!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Dr. Zomboss appears.)
Hsss! Rascals! Gem-poaching scoundrels!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: No matter! My plans proceed apace!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The zombies are aware of our gem quest, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: They intend to attack us from the sea.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: We'll sea about that! Bowling Bulbs, LET'S ROLL!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Epic Quest - Rescue the Gold Bloom - Step 1

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I smell leather! And electricity!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: My sensors register a plant lost in time.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I smell a rescue! And oranges!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Epic Quest - Rescue the Gold Bloom - Step 2 (Intro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Our missing plant is the Gold Bloom, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It produces an immediate bounty of sun when planted!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Instant sun? Not good enough! MUST GO FASTER!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Epic Quest - Rescue the Gold Bloom - Step 2 (Outro)

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
The Gold Bloom is unstuck in time, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Luckily I can track it whenever it goes.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Hang on, little sprout! We're a-comin'!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)

dialogues.title: Epic Quest - Rescue the Gold Bloom - Step 7

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
We did it! I am a hero to all plants!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I am concerned about the strange portals we encountered, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I believe some unfortunate chicanery may be afoot.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss appears; Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
HA! HA-HA-HA! HA!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: I am amused!
lines.speaker: Dr. Zomboss

lines.text: (Dr. Zomboss leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Penny, look! Above my head!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It’s the TRAVEL LOG!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: What's that, Travel Log? You provide guidance, progress and rewards?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: The Log is not, in fact, speaking, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Thanks, Travel Log! Whatever you say!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Oh no, zombies ate your brains!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: {tutorial} (Note: as in the original.)
Good thing you got two more!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Big Bad Butte!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And by big I mean crawling with zombies...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Pyramid of Doom!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: It's just like a regular pyramid, but... you know... doomier.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hello, neighbor! Welcome to the endless challenge!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Here you need to face the endless onslaught of zombies. Please choose 5 plants to form your lineup. Let's see how far you can go!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Here you need to face the endless onslaught of zombies. Please choose 5 plants to form your lineup. Let's see how far you can go!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hi neighbor! Welcome to Dead Man's Booty!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I'd plunder that.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Nice pick, let's see how far you can get!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
The Endless Zones are harder than usual!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Power Ups and Plant Food can only be purchased once per level.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Good luck!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Great work neighbor!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: {tutorial} (Note: as in the original.)
In the Endless Zones, your lawn mowers carry over to the next level!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: {tutorial} (Note: as in the original.)
Your Plant Food carries over to the next level as well!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: {tutorial} (Note: as in the original.)
Now it's time to pick another plant!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
These are your starting plants!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Now you get to pick one more.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hi neighbor! Welcome to The Tiki Torch-er!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: But Beware! Zombies are selling seashells by this seashore!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: And they insist you pay in brains!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hi neighbor! Welcome to Arthur's Challenge!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Here you'll find that day is night and knights are zombies!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Howdy neighbor! Welcome to La Brainsa Tarpits!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I hope you're ready for a reptilian rumble!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to the GREATEST HITS!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: I hope you're ready for a righteously up-tempo experience!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Terror from Tomorrow!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Making tomorrow's terror something terrible for today!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Icebound Battleground!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: This place is cold as, uh, ICE... not to mention chock full o' zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Best bring some hot zombie-fightin' moves. And maybe a nice warm coat too.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Temple of Bloom!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Here you'll find that gold is good but brings out more zombies!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to Highway to the Danger Room!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Endless Zone - Lawn Mower Refill Success

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
Great work neighbor!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

Your Plant Food carries over to the next level!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: {tutorial} (Note: as in the original.)
Now it's time to pick another plant!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)

dialogues.title: Endless Challenge - Plant Pool Selection Tutorial

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Wow, you have a lot of plants now.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It seems to be inconvenient in endless mode.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Now you can choose some of your favorite plants to bring to the endless challenge.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: At the same time, the number of plants will only be replenished among the plants you selected.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Found Camel Zombies ahead. Their defense is very strong, and it will take a long time to defeat them with normal attacks.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Bloomerang. One attack can penetrate multiple targets, which is very suitable for fighting Camel Zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
We found the Tomb Raiser Zombie ahead. He will intermittently summon a tombstone to disrupt our formation. We must eliminate it as soon as possible.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Let's try the newly arrived Bonk Choy. He is known for his high attack speed, punches to the flesh, and can output astonishing damage.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
A Barrel Roller Zombie is found ahead. When the roller explodes, the Imps inside are released. Be careful.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Snapdragon. His firepower covers the upper, middle and lower rows. He is a representative of range attack plants.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Seagull zombies are found ahead. They will fly across the river and attack our weak areas from the air.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Kernel-pult, which can instantly kill seagull zombies when throwing corn chunks.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
I'm tired of having to take a long time to plant all the cash crops.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Twin Sunflower. Her yield is twice that of ordinary Sunflowers, thus saving limited land.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Pianist Zombies are found ahead. The sound of their piano will make the surrounding zombies dance and change their paths.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Spikerock. Planting them under the feet of Pianist Zombies can directly destroy them.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Chicken Wrangler Zombies are found ahead. When they die, they will throw a large wave of chickens and attack your formation.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Fire Gourd, he can perfectly break the chicken formation.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Disco-tron 3000 is found ahead, he will summon many followers to harass us.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Starfruit. He is cost-effective and can cause a lot of damage to scattered targets.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
A Gargantuar Prime is found ahead. He will instantly kill the plants passing by.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Citron. The single-target damage burst is extremely strong, and the ultimate move can effectively restrain the Gargantuar Primes.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
A Jester Zombie is found ahead, and he will reflect our long-range attacks.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Fume-shroom. His attack is immune to the damage caused by Jester Zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
A Knight Zombie is found in front. He can easily break through our formation.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Pryo-shroom, which can generate a wall of fire to block zombie attacks.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Fisherman Zombie is found in front, he will attack us from behind.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Lotus Pod. His Plant Food effect will prioritize attacking zombies at the rear, especially Fisherman Zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Shell Zombie is found ahead. His shell can withstand a lot of damage.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Acid Lemon. His attack can corrode the shell and cause extra damage.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Buckethead Pirates are found ahead. They are very tough and difficult to defeat.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try out the newly arrived Repeaters, they do double the damage compared to Peashooters.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
A Chicken Wrangler Zombie is found ahead. When he dies, he will release many fast-moving chickens to quickly break through your formation.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Lightning Reed. His high-frequency lightning is best for fried chicken steaks.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
I found a Hammer Zombie in front who can deflect straight-shot projectiles. Very annoying.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the new arrival, Dandelion. His projectiles track enemies and can't be deflected by Hammer Zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
A frozen plant was found ahead, and conventional attack methods would take a long time to thaw.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Plant the Pepper-pult around frozen plants, and her aura will thaw nearby plants.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Walrus zombies are found ahead. After they die, they will turn into slopes to help the Ski Zombies rush over.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Try the newly arrived Whirlwind Acorns, which are designed to restrain the Walrus Zombie, break its teeth, and prevent the Ski Zombie from sprinting.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
(Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
My Penny sense has detected a rare and curious lunch box.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave appears.)
I smell a Yeti! Let's go after him!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny and Crazy Dave leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Uh-oh, the road is forked. What do we do?!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Those are where you flex your brains with new plants and upgrades.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I've named them Brain Busters.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Brain busting? Very dangerous. You go first.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
It seems that a set of tubes is enough to play with space and time, just like my uncle Milo's water park!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Watch out for these ingots, don't let zombies steal them!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Enhanced props are online, attack.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: It's like magic, but better!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Any solution using advanced technology is as gorgeous as magic.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
Data shows there's never been a better time to use your secret weapon.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: These tactical cucumbers are given to you, don't ask why, because I'm crazy~!!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Look! There's a Gourd! Is there any wine inside?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Be careful, this gourd seems to have high attack power.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I know, he can burn these weapon stands with fire!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
The frozen ball cannot be connected! Eliminate the surrounding balls to melt it~
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Special zombies found ahead! Defeating this zombie can get a lot of balls of the corresponding color!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Whirlwind Acorns can restrain walrus zombies.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
In this level, you can directly choose cards to plant plants.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Connect balls of the same color and see what happens.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave and Penny appear.)
I am picking up a grid of plants, User Dave.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: My scans suggest that they can be swapped to create matches of three.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: I saw a game like that once on my telephoney!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: You can use sun to upgrade the plants.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Make 100 matches to defeat the zombies!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Whoa, mowers can chase down zombies and just keep going!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Keep an eye out for mowers dropped by zombies, but in the meantime...
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Let me get your mowers back to fightin' form.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Don't worry, this one's on the house, or next to the house.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Now here's a break with tradition.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: Facebreaker is a blast from the past, right to your face!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
It's called Vasebreaker, User Dave. Vasebreaker.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: In that case, it must be right to your vase!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Hey! There seem to be several high-end cars parked in front, much better than yours, Penny!
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Penny appears.)
Then you can choose one and let us compete in speed!
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: Okay, but after I win, you have to give me an identical car.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave and Penny leave.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Wow, there seems to be a huge zombie.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
Be careful, this is not easy to deal with.
lines.speaker: Penny

lines.text: (Penny leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
Let me attack with my favorite peashooter.
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Crazy Dave appears.)
What's going on? I can't move at all. What should I do?
lines.speaker: Crazy Dave

lines.text: (Crazy Dave leaves.)
(Penny appears.)
